subject: electrical apparatus
description: There are two items under consideration in this request, a current-carrying electrical support rail identified as material number 22169087, TECTON T 5 WH (Article 1) and an electrical feed-in module identified as material number 22169063, TECTON SF WH (Article 2). subject: autonomous driving module
description: The merchandise under consideration is described as an Integrated Performance Computer Unit (IPCU) used within a vehicle in order to facilitate autonomous driving. The subject device is comprised of two printed circuit board assemblies (PCBA), both comprised of a main processing unit, memory, and various communication and connection components. The first PCBA is stated to be dedicated to autonomous driving and parking functions. The second is meant to connect and communicate with various systems and apparatus within a designated vehicle. These include cameras, radar, radio, phones, and others. The subject unit is placed within a vehicle and functions as a centralized platform that consolidates data from multiple vehicle sources. With this information, the device runs artificial intelligence algorithms allowing the vehicle to function autonomously.

subject: digital effects processor
description: The merchandise under consideration is identified as the Neural DSP Quad Cortex, which is further described as a digital guitar and instrument effects processor. The subject device is comprised of a metal enclosure, within which are the necessary electrical components. On the outside of the device is a 7-inch LCD touchscreen interface along with a rotary encoder and multiple footswitches. On the back of the device are the various input and output connections, including audio inputs (XLR, TRS, mono, etc.), MIDI, and USB. subject: F-16 simulator cockpit shell
description: Informational material was submitted with your request. The merchandise under consideration is an F-16 simulator cockpit shell meant to simulate the experience of piloting a fighter jet. It is a life-sized stationary metal body resembling the cockpit of an F-16 fighter jet and when assembled covers an approximate area of 47 square feet with a height up to 33 inches. After importation it will be assembled and fitted with additional furnishings and gaming equipment making it more realistic. The cockpit shell features a space for a user to sit acting as the pilot, a metal body extending out from the cockpit opening resembling a portion of the fighter jet’s fuselage, and a metal ladder attached to the side for a user to enter and leave the cockpit. We note that the cockpit shell is composed of two metals: steel and aluminum.

subject: environmental monitoring and condition-sensing tag
description: Descriptive literature was provided for our review. The item under consideration is described as the SD-D05 (A·TRACS), which is a composite, self-contained, battery-powered electronic sensor tag enclosed in a compact plastic housing. It is designed primarily as a wireless environmental-monitoring and condition-sensing tag for utilization in transportation, logistics, and supply-chain asset management. The device incorporates an array of integrated micro-sensors engineered to measure, log, and monitor ambient environmental criteria (including temperature, relative humidity, light exposure, and tri-axial acceleration (shock/tilt)) to verify the structural and thermal integrity of commercial cargo during transit. Data acquisition is managed by an internal microcontroller that automatically cross-references environmental measurements against user-defined safety thresholds.

subject: contemporary artwork

subject: diaphragm expansion tanks
description: The products in question are Hydrapro thermal expansion tanks, models HPTET2 (2 gallon) and HPTET45 (4.5 gallon). The expansion tanks are constructed of a welded steel shell and installed near a water heater to absorb thermally expanded heated water. This allows a place for the heated water to expand out of the water heater and not exert undue pressure within the potable water plumbing system. The expansion tanks consists of two chambers separated by a rubber diaphragm. Water enters on one side of the diaphragm while air is on the other. As water is heated in the water heater tank, the water expands, creating pressure. The hot water then travels to the thermal expansion tank to be temporarily held. This helps alleviate pressure build up in the potable water plumbing system. The water presses on the diaphragm, compressing the air.

subject: hydraulic hose ferrules and hose-end inserts
description: Product information was submitted with your request. The items under consideration are ferrules and hose-end inserts which will be used to manufacture flexible hydraulic hose assemblies. You describe the hose-end inserts as “stems” which are specifically dimensioned for insertion into the ends of hydraulic hose. The insert forms the fluid-conducting termination of the completed hydraulic hose assembly. After the insert is positioned inside the hose-end, a corresponding ferrule is placed over the hose and permanently crimped to mechanically secure the connection. The completed assemblies will be used to connect hoses to components such as pumps, cylinders, and valves to efficiently transfer high pressure hydraulic fluid in mobile and industrial machinery. The ferrules and inserts consist of plated carbon steel or stainless steel and are produced in various sizes.

subject: automotive shim
description: The merchandise under consideration is identified as an an automotive shim, Part Number 530404G100. The subject article is a precision, ring-shaped component manufactured from SK5 high-carbon tool steel. It measures approximately 33 mm in inner diameter, 51 mm in outer diameter, and 1.86 mm in thickness. The shim is designed for use in the differential carrier assembly of a motor vehicle. The shim is installed between the drive pinion gear and the inner pinion bearing. Within the differential assembly, it adjusts the mounting depth and relative position of the drive pinion gear in relation to the ring gear. The shim also controls axial clearance and assists in maintaining the proper preload of the inner pinion bearing. These functions promote proper gear engagement and rotational stability within the differential assembly.

subject: Frozen Raw Yellowfin Tuna
description: The subject merchandise consists of three frozen raw yellowfin tuna products identified as Tuna Loins, Tuna Steaks, and Tuna Cubes. You state that the products are made from frozen, raw, gutted, and skinless yellowfin tuna (Thunnus albacares) that undergoes a proprietary enhancement process prior to freezing and exportation. During processing, a formulated brine containing functional ingredients is injected directly into the muscle tissue of the tuna. The brine remains in the finished product and is intended to improve moisture retention, texture, yield, appearance, color stability, shelf life, and overall product performance. The products are imported frozen and are intended primarily for use in the food service industry.

subject: mobile shore power outlet system
description: Your request concerns two items collectively referred to as the igus Mobile Shore Power Outlet (iMSPO) system, which is used to connect externally generated shore power to a berthed vessel. You describe two configurations in which the iMSPO system may be imported, detailed as follows: In Scenario 1, the iMSPO carriage and its onboard equipment are imported. In this configuration, the imported article is the iMSPO carriage—a self-propelled shore-side electrical interface that can be positioned at any point along a marine terminal berth—along with its onboard mechanical, electrical, control, communication, grounding, and safety-interlocking equipment. This equipment comprises two drive motor/gearbox/wheel assemblies (rated 400/480 V, three-phase, up to 36 kW each); socket boxes rated at 6.

subject: acoustic location aid
description: The merchandise under consideration is identified as the Echo Smart Activ, which is further described as an acoustic location aid for visually impaired dogs. The subject device is comprised of two piezoelectric ultrasonic emitters along with internal electronic control circuitry and an internal rechargeable battery. These components are enclosed within a plastic housing and attached to a collar strap, which is meant to be worn on the neck of the dog. In use, the device is placed on the neck of the blind or visually impaired animal and emits an acoustic sound that bounces off the objects in the surrounding area. The dog hears the sound reverberations and perceives the objects, allowing the dog to move around the area freely. The device does not receive or process the sound; it only emits and allows the dog to develop a form of echo location.

subject: MDF Halloween table decoration
description: You submitted a photograph and detailed description of an item identified as SKU HY7052, MDF Table Decoration. subject: optical radiation exposure chamber
description: Descriptive literature was provided for our review. The item under consideration is described as an optical radiation exposure chamber system, which is a custom-built, single-unit designed apparatus housed within a 20-foot shipping container. The system is specifically built to perform Light-Induced Degradation (LID) testing on photovoltaic (PV) modules by subjecting them to controlled optical radiation and temperature. This allows the system to simulate years of outdoor field exposure in a compressed timeframe to evaluate their reliability, durability, and long-term performance. Operationally, the apparatus features a Ceramic Metal Halide (CMH) and Quartz Tungsten Halogen (QTH) lamp array that emits optical radiation (spanning the ultraviolet, visible, and infrared spectrums) characterized against the AM1.5G reference spectrum.

subject: automated body scanner
description: Descriptive literature was provided for our review. The item under consideration is described as an automated retail capsule (ARC), which is a dome-shaped, walk-in aluminum structure designed for use in retail environments. The ARC functions as a controlled environment for measuring a customer’s body dimensions to facilitate the production of made-to-measure clothing. The interior features two changing rooms and a central body-scanning room equipped with a TG3D Scanatic360 body scanner. This scanner utilizes infrared, structured-light sensor technology to capture a full-body 3D scan in approximately three seconds, generating over 250 individual body measurements. Following the scanning process, the customer’s measurements are automatically linked to their profile.

subject: Metalogix Revolution External Plating System

subject: battery-operated rodent snap trap from the Czech Republic
description: The Emitter® Tubetrap 2.0, item number 160215-Set (Tubetrap), is a reusable professional rodent-control device designed to detect and mechanically capture rodents. subject: industrial water cooling tower
description: The merchandise under consideration is an industrial steel water cooling tower, model number OTTX-350L, with an induced-draft, cross-flow, and open-circuit design. It features a cold-water basin, a hot-water basin, and dual vertical fill banks mounted in a structural frame enclosed by panels. During its operation, hot process water is piped to the top of the unit, where it is distributed by gravity over PVC packing in the fill banks, which are located on opposite sides of the unit. At the top of the unit is an induced-draft fan assembly equipped with an axial air-foil fan. The fan draws ambient air into the unit, where it flows perpendicular to the falling water and then passes through drift eliminators before exiting the tower. It is also indicated for use in secondary amenorrhea. In your letter, you stated the country of origin is China and exported out of India.

subject: “MOZA R3 Direct Drive Racing Simulator Kit (PC Version)”
description: Photographs and descriptive literature were provided for our review. The item under consideration is the “MOZA R3 Direct Drive Racing Simulator Kit (PC Version)” consisting of a steering wheel, steering wheel base, pedals, desk clamp, power adapter and USB data cable. The kit is imported into the United States in retail packaging and contains a complete set of racing game control peripherals. It is designed to connect to a personal computer (PC) via a USB interface and operate racing simulation games in conjunction with an external display (such as an HDTV or computer monitor). The kit is not a standalone game console; it does not contain game content or a computing unit. Rather, it functions as a dedicated input/output control device for the PC platform, designed to enhance the realistic driving experience in racing games.

subject: paper party decoration
description: You submitted photographs and a detailed description of an item identified as a Decorative Tissue Paper Garland, item number HP9303, which consists of a garland made of multiple pre-folded and die-cut tissue paper fan segments in assorted colors. Each fan segment is permanently attached to an internal string, forming a continuous decorative garland. The tissue paper segments are fixed in an open fan shape and are evenly spaced along the string. The garland has string ties at the ends to facilitate hanging. The flimsy, single-use decoration is marketed and sold as a temporary party decoration.

subject: refrigerant receiver tank
description: Product information and photos were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is item Y26-00054, a 3.4-liter, steel, cylindrical, pressurized container that holds liquid refrigerant. The container is attached to the condenser coil of an HVAC system and is designed to collect and store liquid refrigerant. The container incorporates no mechanical components or valves.

subject: Gabi System
description: The item under consideration is described as the Gabi System, which is a non-invasive, child-friendly, wearable device designed for continuous monitoring of pulse rate and blood volume variations. Utilizing advanced photoplethysmography (PPG) technology, the system employs red, infrared, and green LEDs to capture micro-fluctuations in blood circulation, translating optical absorption data into precise Pulse Rate (PR) and Oxygen Saturation (SpO2) metrics. This physiological data is securely transmitted in real-time via Bluetooth to mobile and cloud-based platforms, allowing parents and clinicians to monitor cardiovascular trends and review historical waveforms without disrupting the child’s daily routine or rest.

subject: steel compression limiter
description: Photographs and descriptions of the merchandise were included in your inquiry. The article under consideration is described as a compression limiter, part number PINSS093F. It is a cylindrical steel component with an oval inner hole and a knurled outer edge that is used in conjunction with a bolt or screw as part of a fastening system. This compression limiter is designed for and used exclusively on an alternator splash shield cover for a specific motor vehicle and functions as a sleeve or spacer. It is pressed into place in the plastic cover and secured by a flanged hex head bolt. The bolt head clamps against the compression limiter instead of directly on the plastic.

subject: Alpha Eagle
description: The merchandise under consideration is identified as an Alpha Eagle, which you describe as a self-propelled, boom-mounted machine designed primarily for forestry and vegetation control work. The machine consists of an articulated chassis with a permanently integrated 33-foot telescopic hydraulic boom mounted to the side of the machine and a 90° rotating cab with wide visibility and in-cab controls. The Alpha Eagle has a 4-wheel drive traction system and is powered by a 4-cylinder, liquid cooled diesel engine with 173 HP (129 kW).

subject: RoboMIDI and RoboMAX
description: The merchandise under consideration is identified as the RoboMIDI and RoboMAX, which you describe as two tracked, remote-controlled tool carriers that are designed and marketed primarily for forestry and wild vegetation control. The RoboMIDI and RoboMAX are diesel-powered carriers operated by a multifunction remote with a working range of approximately 492 feet, allowing precise control of movement, steering, and attachment positioning. Both models are offered with multiple track configurations to adapt to varied terrain. The machines are not intended for the transportation of goods or passengers over public roads and are not designed for hauling or pushing. Their functionality is limited to tasks performed via front-mounted work tools.

subject: costume
description: You submitted a sample of an adult size costume identified as My Melody Darling, item numbers -037 and WMT5027-037, which consist of a pullover dress and hooded short cape.

subject: self-wound aluminum foil tape
description: The product under consideration is described as a self-wound pressure-sensitive adhesive aluminum foil tape. It consists of aluminum foil, approximately 40 microns (0.04 mm) in thickness, coated on one side with an acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive. The adhesive-coated foil is slit to a width of approximately 2 inches and wound into rolls approximately 2,000 feet in length on a 3-inch core. The product is imported in self-wound rolls without a release liner, backing material, or carrier layer, with the adhesive surface contacting the aluminum foil surface of the next layer in the roll. The merchandise is imported as a finished pressure-sensitive adhesive tape ready for industrial use.

subject: Dried Poppy Heads from the United Kingdom
description: The subject merchandise consists of naturally grown poppy seed capsules (Papaver somniferum) that have been harvested and dried. You state that there are no materials or substances added. Furthermore, you state the poppy heads are imported solely for decorative use, including home décor, floral arrangements, arts and crafts, and interior design applications. They are not intended for planting, propagation, food, pharmaceutical, medicinal, or narcotic purposes. The drying process renders the product unsuitable for cultivation, and it is marketed and sold exclusively as an ornamental botanical item. The merchandise is exported to the United States in protective cartons and will be available in a variety of retail and wholesale pack sizes.

subject: hexane-1,3,6-tricarbonotrile (CAS No. 1772-25-4) in bulk form,
description: The subject merchandise consists of hexane-1,3,6-tricarbonotrile (CAS No. -25-4), in liquid form, with a purity of 99.5 percent or greater. The product is primarily used as an additive in lithium-ion battery electrolytes.

subject: earrings
description: You have submitted photographs and descriptions for our review. The merchandise at issue are earrings constructed of baked polymer clay. The minor components such as jump rings and posts are composed of stainless steel plated in gold.

subject: bearing steel balls
description: The products under consideration are bearing steel balls. Each ball is polished, weighs 10.02 grams and is constructed of SUJ2 graded steel. The balls are designed to be used in bearings that minimize friction in steering columns, wheel hub units and pumps.

subject: control panel subassembly
description: The item at issue with this request is an aircraft cockpit Multifunction Control and Display Unit (MCDU) control panel subassembly, identified by part number 865-000163-2Z. The control panel subassembly is a component of the MCDU. A complete MCDU is installed in the cockpit of an aircraft and functions as the interface between the flight crew and the aircraft’s Flight Management System. The Flight Management System allows the the flight crew to input, select, modify, and display flight management information including the flight plan, navigation, and aircraft system data, et al. In it’s imported condition, the control panel subassembly cannot function as a complete MCDU because it does not contain an LCD display nor is it calibrated or tested for final use.

subject: 2000 Subaru Impreza WRX STI
description: The item under consideration has been identified as a used  Subaru Impreza WRX STI from Japan. You state that the car is a sedan designed for carrying five (5) passengers, including the driver. The vehicle is equipped with a Subaru EJ207 4-cylinder (1,994 cc) turbocharged spark-ignition internal combustion piston engine, which remains unmodified. The vehicle is configured with right-hand drive and bears chassis number GD8-001368, which serves as the vehicle identification number for this Japanese-market vehicle.

subject: new electric vehicle
description: The item under consideration has been identified as the all-electric Hyundai GV60. The Magma is a five-door sport utility coupe powered by an all-electric engine. You state that the vehicle is equipped with a 600 horsepower All Wheel Drive electric motor, and seating for 5 people. You state that the all-electric range is 222 miles.

subject: mobility scooter
description: The item under consideration has been identified as the MJMA02 Helix 2 Power Mobility Scooter that is intended for use by individuals with limited mobility to travel independently over flat indoor or outdoor surfaces for daily activities. The four-wheeled, battery-powered scooter features the following: Four-wheel steering system Removable footrest extension Anti-tip rear wheels 4-way adjustable tiller Adjustable padded backrest Fold-flat design for storage Li-Ion 24 Volt / 5.

subject: 2000 Nissan Skyline 25GT-X
description: The item under consideration has been identified as a used  Nissan Skyline 25GT-X from Japan. You state that the car is a sedan designed for carrying five (5) passengers, including the driver. The vehicle is equipped with a Nissan RB25DE 6-cylinder (2,500cc) spark-ignition internal combustion piston engine. The engine is otherwise unmodified except for an aftermarket exhaust system. The vehicle also features cosmetic and suspension modifications, including aftermarket wheels, coilover suspension, and a body kit.

subject: fire resistant case
description: You have submitted a samplewhich will be retained by this office.Item BL25FKBGY, which you have referred to as a fire and water resistant keepsake box, is a soft-sidedtextile case constructed with an outer surface coated with silicone. It is akin to a briefcase.

subject: digital signal processor
description: The merchandise under consideration, identified by model number DSPx 2.4, is described as a digital signal processor (DSP) used within high-performance loudspeaker systems. The subject device is comprised of various electronic components, including an onboard DSP chipset, enclosed within a metal housing. The front of the device includes a rotary dial, while the back is equipped with various input and output connections. These include analog audio, i.e. RCA and XLR, digital audio, i.e. S/PDIF, as well as wireless connectivity. You state that the device is designed to receive and process an audio signal from an input source. This processing includes the conversion of a digital signal to analog to be used by various outputs, such as speakers, tweeter, subwoofers, etc. Additionally, the device can divide the frequencies, perform equalization, and adjust levels across various channels.

subject: wearable monitor
description: The merchandise under consideration is identified as the “MeganeX 8K Mark II,” model number SVP-VGC4B, a virtual reality (VR) head-mounted display. This wearable monitor displays images on two 1.35-inch micro-OLED screens. Based on the information provided, the device does not contain a battery and cannot operate unless connected to a PC. Moreover, it receives video and automatic data processing (ADP) signals directly from an ADP machine and displays them in a form that meets the user’s requirements. It does not contain an operating system or have interactive functions.

subject: steel decorative wall hangings
description: Photographs and descriptions of the merchandise were included in your inquiry. The articles under consideration are described as a handcrafted decorative wildlife ornament in the shape of a gecko, butterfly, owl, or dragonfly. Each decorative item is constructed of a galvanized or stainless-steel wire frame that is shaped into the form of the subject. Colored glass beads are threaded onto the wire to cover the frame. The finished ornaments are of different sizes, ranging from 10 inches to 79 inches. Each item has a wire loop to hang it on a wall or other vertical surface and is intended for indoor or outdoor decorative use as wall art or patio décor.

subject: printed circuit board assembly
description: The merchandise under consideration is a printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), known as the Pulse 2.0 Logic Board. This PCBA is further described as the network communication subsystem of the Pulse 2.0 Industrial Energy Monitor. The Logic Board PCBA’s primary function is to receive digitized energy measurement data from a co-mounted Energy Board via an internal serial peripheral interface (SPI) bus, convert that data into MQTT-formatted JSON payloads over a TLS 1.3-secured TCP/IP stack, and transmit those payloads to nClarity's cloud infrastructure via WiFi or a USB-connected Ethernet module. In your request, you suggest the Pulse 2.

subject: paper party decoration
description: You submitted photographs and a detailed description of an item identified as SKU # 45534601, Paper Fringe Banner, which consists of a pre-assembled, paper party banner made of multiple layers of colored tissue paper cut into 0.39” wide fringe, and is glued to a polyester string. The item features 7.48” long fringe and is approximately 9.84” in length and features string ties at the ends for temporary display. The flimsy, single use item will be marketed and sold as a party decoration.

subject: sign frame
description: Informational material was submitted with your request. The item under consideration is a sign frame identified as the “Galvanized Steel H-Frame Sign Stake.” The frame consists of four galvanized steel wires welded together in the shape of an “H” with two vertical wires welded to two horizontal wires. The frame is 24 inches in height and 10 inches in width. It is designed to support corrugated polypropylene (PP) yard signs by inserting the upper vertical support wires into the flutes of a corrugated sign panel. The lower vertical support wires are then inserted into the ground to provide temporary support for outdoor signage such as signs for political campaigns, real estate, contractor advertising, or construction project signs.

subject: side-by-side vehicle
description: The item under consideration, identified as “The Can-Am Maverick R 1001T,” is a side-by-side vehicle (“SSV”) designed for off-road use. According to your submission, it is intended for operation over challenging terrain, including sand, desert, trails, and rocky environments, and is available in two- and four-passenger configurations with occupants seated side-by-side. The vehicle is powered by a spark-ignition internal combustion piston engine with a displacement of 1,001 cc and is capable of reaching speeds of approximately 100 mph. It is designed for extended off-road travel and incorporates an integrated rollover protection structure. Based on the information provided, we find that the subject article is a motor vehicle principally designed for the transport of persons.

subject: bellows
description: Informational material was submitted with your request. The merchandise under consideration is a bellows, product # GF6--51522. It is designed to function as a housing and seal for an actuating piston used in gas pressure control valves. The bellows consists of a corrugated tube made of inconel, a nickel-based alloy, and two stainless steel fittings attached to both ends. The corrugated tube is flexible and can expand and contract with the piston as it moves from a length of 55 millimeters to a maximum of 158 millimeters.

subject: collectible miniature studio equipment
description: Images were provided in lieu of samples. The products under consideration are all described as highly detailed, non-functional miniature replicas (at 1/6th scale) of historical electronic recording studio equipment, such as synthesizers and rack-mounted digital samplers. Your submission indicates they are entirely static display pieces and that they contain no electronic components, produce no sound, and possess no moving parts (all knobs, keys, and faders are rigidly fixed to the chassis). These articles are intended to serve as collectible decorations, specifically for creating miniature studio dioramas. They will be made using fused deposition modeling (FDM) 3D printing using polylactic acid (PLA) plastic.

subject: Frozen Salmon Teriyaki Meal
description: You provided a list of ingredients, specifications, description of manufacturing process, and photograph of the product with your submission. The subject merchandise is a Frozen Salmon Teriyaki Meal. The product consists of cooked jasmine rice, Atlantic Salmon, carrots, edamame soybeans, baby corns, water, red bell peppers, sunflower oil, soy sauce, sesame oil, yellow bell peppers, Shio Koji marinade, sugar, modified cornstarch, salt, white sesame seeds, black sesame seeds, garlic, ginger, and flax fiber. The product weighs 340 grams per unit and is imported frozen in a sealed plastic tray. It requires cooking before consumption and is imported for retail sale by Trader Joe’s.

subject: energy storage cabinet kit
description: Product information and photos were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is an energy storage cabinet. You describe the cabinet as being imported in unassembled form, but complete, and then assembled in the United States. You describe the cabinet as "Complete Knocked Down” and designed for use in a “Battery Energy Storage System”. The cabinet measures 6058mm by 2438mm by 2896mm, or 42,722 liters in volume. It is constructed of steel. The steel cabinet does not contain any electrical or mechanical components at time of importation. The cabinet is designed to hold batteries and electrical equipment to function as a power source. The unassembled cabinet includes wall modules, a floor module, a roof module, and battery racks.

subject: wheeled tote bag
description: You have submitted photographs and descriptive literature for our review. Item 1796150, which you have referred to as a laundry hauler, is a tote bag constructed with an outer surface of plastic sheeting. It features casters and four wheels. It has inner foam and a zipper closure. It has three handles: one handle on the right side, and two handles on the front and back sides. The dimensions are 18” L x 14” W x 24” H.

subject: gas-line system
description: The product under consideration is referred to as a life support gas-line system. The packaged system consists of a gas manifold, a zone valve box with an alarm sensor, a gas outlet and an LCD alarm system with accessibility for the visually and hearing impaired. The gas manifold consists of front and back covers that incorporate four regulators, a relief valve and a control box that has pressure transducers that send information to the system’s main circuit board. The valve box features a digital display, a steel enclosure that incorporates a sensor, a range of one to six shutoff valves that are manually actuated, and a pressure gauge. The patient-room outlet consists of a plated assembly with primary and secondary check valves.

subject: house slipper
description: The sample submitted with your request was examined and disposed of. Item 808746 is an open back, closed toe, unisex house slipper. It has a plastic foam padded sherpa-like polyester textile upper that is decorated with embroidered eyes, a nose and a mouth of a pumpkin and a thickly padded midsole. The 1.5 mm thick rubber/plastics outer sole has a layer of embedded textile threads that are visible throughout most of the external surface in contact with the ground.

subject: bowl clamp
description: Images were provided in lieu of a sample. The product under consideration is described as the “Dymmoy Self-Feeding Bowl Clamp.” It is a reusable and washable feeding accessory designed for babies and toddlers that are six months of age and older. This article is used to secure a separate feeding bowl to a dining table or highchair tray during mealtimes to prevent the bowl from being pushed, lifted, tipped, or flipped while a child practices self-feeding under adult supervision. It can accommodate a bowl with a diameter of approximately 8 to 12 centimeters and in a variety of bowl shapes. The item is constructed primarily of acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS) plastic along with internal metal components which support the internal adjustment and clamping mechanism.

subject: dog apparel
description: You have submitted photographs and descriptions for our review. Item 1 is a pullover knit sweater for dogs with a rib-knit turtleneck collar, rib-knit cuffs and hem, two front-leg openings, and a shortened underside. It is constructed predominately of cotton textile material. Item 2 is a dog hoodie and item 3 is similar to item 2 but without the hood. They will be produced of knit fabrics with various fiber contents.

subject: motorized chassis
description: The item under consideration is identified in the request as the “Snow Motorized Chassis Expedition.” As imported, it consists of a propulsion system, including the engine and associated components, mounted onto a chassis. The merchandise is intended for use in the production of Ski-Doo Expedition snowmobiles in the United States. The product includes a liquid-cooled, four-stroke double over head cam (DOHC) engine with a dry sump lubrication system, equipped with a turbocharger, that is mounted onto the chassis. It has a displacement of 899 cc, with three cylinders, and delivers approximately 130 horsepower. Featuring electronic fuel injection (EFI), the engine operates on premium unleaded gasoline (minimum 91 octane). The chassis incorporates a chassis module tunnel, a chassis engine module assembly, and a chassis suspension module assembly.

subject: “Treasure Guess” and “Full Throttle Axolotl” children’s games
description: Photographs and Descriptive literature were provided for our review. “Full Throttle Axolotl” is a children’s game for 2 to 5 players consisting of a toy biker figure, 3 “buddy” cards, 67 game cards, (40 “training wheels” cards, 27 “look, no hands” cards), game instructions and 1 sticker sheet. The “training wheels” cards are designed to be played by younger players while the “look, no hands” cards may be incorporated for older children. The object of the game is to find the 3 “buddy” cards. The “buddy” cards are shuffled with 15 random question cards, placed faced down and spread out onto a table. The game begins by spinning the biker’s head to choose which player goes first. Players flip cards and either answer a question, follow instructions, or find a “buddy” card. The player who takes the next turn is determined by what is written on each card.

subject: polyethylene foam packaging inserts
description: The products under consideration are polyethylene foam packaging inserts used to protect a robotic arm during shipment. The custom-configured foam is cut to profile and hollowed with product-specific internal cavities.

subject: wrist strap and a keychain
description: Informational material was submitted with your request. The items under consideration are a wrist strap and a key chain. The wrist strap, style number PK2203, is identified as the “Live Love Bark Charm Wristlet Strap.” The keychain, style number PK2101, is identified as the “Cat Mom Carded Tassel Keychain.” The wrist strap consists of a steel chain 10 inches long joined together by a brass buckle with polyester webbing woven between the links. The strap is adorned with a single plastic pearl and four zinc dog themed charms hanging along the chain. The key chain consists of a steel key ring 28 millimeters in diameter with a brass chain holding two zinc cat themed charms and a decorative tassel made of polyester rope.

subject: electric motor for submersible wastewater pumps
description: The merchandise under consideration is described as an electric motor for submersible wastewater pumps which is identified by model number DSC4. The electric motor consists of a stator, rotor, and output shaft with bearings but does not include any type of gearing or any attachments. The subject motor is a multi-phase AC motor with maximum power output of 42.5kW and it is intended to be mated to a pump assembly which will be deployed in municipal wastewater systems, industrial effluent handling, drainage, and similar applications where the complete pump assembly operates submerged in the pump medium. We note that the pump is not imported with the electric motor.

subject: automated lumber bundle formation system
description: The subject Automated Lumber Bundle Formation System is engineered to create lumber bundles. The lumber bundles are formed by an automated stacking machine that is positioned between upstream and downstream conveyors and other machines. Due to its overall size, the system will be imported as modules ready for assembly, with all modules imported in a single shipment. The first section consists of a series of conveyors referred to as two Haul Out Chain Modules, an Automated Lumber Distribution Module, and a Lumber Flow Accumulation Module. The Haul Out Chain Modules transport lumber from an upstream Sorter Module (not imported with the system) to the Automated Lumber Distribution Module, which is a chain-type conveyor mounted on a platform that moves horizontally on rails.

subject: iron holders for nautical rope fences
description: Photographs and descriptions of the merchandise were included in your inquiry. The products under consideration are described as iron holders for nautical rope fences. There are two different bracket configurations. The front mount consists of a flat, square, steel plate with a mounting hole in each corner and an iron ring extending perpendicular from the plate. The corner mount consists of flat, square, steel sheet bent to a 90-degree angle with a mounting hole in each corner, and an iron ring extending perpendicular from the outside of the angle. Both styles are made from a mounting plate that measures 2.5 inches square and a 3.8-inch solid steel ring, and both configurations are imported in sizes to support a 1-inch or 2-inch diameter nautical rope within the ring. The surface finish can be raw iron or painted black.

subject: Turnout Remover and Carrier System
description: The Turnout Remover and Carrier System (TRACS) is a type of railroad infrastructure maintenance and construction machine. It is designed to lift and transport prefabricated railway track sections, such as railway switch and crossing track panels, underneath its frame. The machine has an adjustable frame, allowing it to straddle railway tracks of different rail gauges. The TRACS is self-propelled, diesel-powered, and remotely operated. It features hydraulically powered telescopic columns at each corner of its rectangular frame. The columns are mounted on two mobile crawler track bases, and the frame is equipped with an engine, a startup control box, a remote-control receiver, and a central lifting assembly. The lifting assembly consists of a high-capacity hydraulic ram with 1.

subject: printed wall hanging
description: Product information and a sample were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is item# DS0048005, the “3D Glitter Diamond Painting Kit.” The kit comprises a medium-density fiberboard (MDF) frame featuring an image of a cat wearing a jester-style collar embellished with green glitter, along with the word “meow” set against a background of burgundy and blue stripes. The image is UV printed on MDF board. Also included with the kit are eight pouches with plastic “diamonds,” each labeled with a number corresponding to the numbered dots printed on the cat and the word “meow,” one stylus tool, one plastic tray, and a 2-centimeter square piece of wax.

subject: fixed thick film chip resistor
description: The product concerned is a fixed thick film chip resistor used in surface-mount technology (SMT) applications, part # TFR16GJ273V. This item is an individual passive electronic component consisting of an alumina ceramic substrate, a printed thick-film resistive element, conductive terminal electrodes at both ends, and a protective glass overcoat. The resistive element is laser-trimmed to achieve the specified resistance value. The resistor is designed to provide a predetermined electrical resistance for electronic circuits by limiting current, dividing voltage, and stabilizing circuit operation. It contains no active semiconductor devices or integrated circuits.

subject: tire repair kit
description: The merchandise under consideration is identified as a Tire Repair Kit (model number 60301). You stated that it is used for emergency tire puncture repair primarily for bicycles but can also be used for automotive tubeless tire repair and maintenance. The kit consists of the following Chinese-origin items: 1 pc T-Handle Spiral Tool 1 pc T-Handle Insert Tool 10 pcs Vulcanized Rubber Tire Plugs 4 pcs Zinc Alloy Valve Core Stems and Plastic Caps 1 pc Tire Gauge 1 pc Valve Stem Removal Tool 1 pc Allen Wrench 1 pc Blade 1 pc Mini Pry Tool 1 pc Plier 1 pc Lubricant 1 pc Screwdriver 1 box Rubber Nails (4 pcs small and 4 pcs large) All of the items will be imported packaged together for retail sale in a polyester carry bag.

subject: portable reading stand
description: Informational material was submitted with your request. The item under consideration is a portable reading stand. The stand consists of a stainless steel base plate and a stainless steel support arm which are joined together by hinges allowing them to fold together for portability or fold out for use. The support arm is approximately 1 inch wide by 6.75 inches in length, and the base plate is 4.5 inches by 3.75 inches on one end tapering down to 1 inch in width on the other where it is attached to the support arm. When in use the base plate rests on a flat surface, the support arm folds out at a 45-degree angle and slides into a spine sleeve of a specially designed book cover, which is not included, allowing the user to read and study the book at an elevated angle.

subject: roof rack system
description: The article under consideration is a roof rack system engineered and configured for a specific vehicle. The product named “SpaceRack” is composed of extruded aluminum profiles of alloy EN AW- T66, laser CNC-cut aluminum plates of alloy AlMg3 (EN AW-), and stainless steel components and fasteners (approximately 70% aluminum and 30% stainless steel by weight). The components are laser-cut to vehicle unique specifications. The system is imported unassembled as one complete kit, containing all necessary parts required for installation. Once assembled, the device is permanently mounted on the roof of the specific motor vehicle and serves to carry loads on that vehicle.

subject: pre-install cable set from the Netherlands
description: The merchandise under consideration is a pre-install cable set referred to as the NXE 3800E Pre-Install Cable Set. The pre-install cable set is further described as a cable set consisting of optical fiber, electrical, and communications cables. The set includes approximately 158 cables or cable bundles and 50 other brackets or connectors which comprise the complete assembly. In use, the pre-install cable set is a component of the NXE 3880E Extreme Ultraviolet semiconductor lithography system. In your request, you describe two scenarios in which the pre-install cable set may be imported. In scenario 1, all items in the pre-install cable set are imported together in a single shipment. In scenario 2, the pre-install cable set is split into two shipments, shipment “A” and shipment “B”.

subject: molded plastic case
description: You have submitted photographs and descriptive literature for a review. The article at issue, which you referred to as a tool case, is a molded plastic case similar to a briefcase or attaché case. The case is structured and rigid on all sides. The interior has a foam insert that is not specially shaped or fitted for a particular item or set of items. The case is intended to perform the useful functions of storing, protecting, organizing, and transporting the intended contents.

subject: PET/Aluminum composite film
description: The samples which you provided will be retained by this office. The product under consideration is described as a PET/Aluminum composite film consisting of a 12-micron (0.012 mm) thick layer of PET film, a 6.35-micron (0.00635 mm) thick layer of aluminum foil, and a 2-micron (0.002 mm) thick 2K-PU adhesive which bonds the PET film and foil together. The panels are used in the production of electronic devices as a passive component.

subject: status light assembly
description: The item concerned is a light emitting diode (“LED”) status bar assembly referred to as the F2 LED Assembly, part # 1013272. This status bar assembly is composed of a stainless-steel housing, an LED diffuser made of polycarbonate, and an LED printed circuit board which is an electronics board made of flame-retardant fiberglass-reinforced epoxy resin, with the LED chips (RGB LED chips) mounted on it. In use, this status light is installed within the “fastmill.io™ In-Office Mill,” an in-office milling machine, used in the dental field. The milling machine’s programmable logic controller communicates with the status light when signals are received from corresponding components/systems within the machine.

subject: “huupe ARENA” system
description: Photographs and Descriptive literature were provided for our review. The item under consideration is described as the ARENA video game console, which utilizes a camera-free sensor array combining LiDAR and radar technology to track basketball shots with over 99% accuracy. The LiDAR system operates on the time-of-flight principle, emitting rapid, invisible pulses of laser light toward the court or backboard area. When a basketball or player interrupts the beam, the light reflects back to the sensor’s detector. By measuring the precise nanosecond travel time of the returning light pulse, the onboard processor calculates distance. This continuous stream of range and trajectory data maps the 3D coordinates of the ball’s movement, allowing the device to distinguish makes, misses, and shot distance entirely without optical video recording.

subject: brake pad shims
description: The items under consideration are two brake pad shims, part numbers 100321307 and 100321602. You state that each shim is constructed of nitrile rubber, galvanized steel, and a silicone-based adhesive layer. The shim is designed to be affixed to a disc brake pad to prevent the vehicle’s brake pads and rotors from coming into contact with each other. These shims also correct small imperfections in the vehicle’s braking system that can cause brake noise.

subject: phone wallets
description: You have submitted samples which will be retained by our office. The submitted samples, Walgreens Item Code (“WIC”) 669974, are novelty wallets that can be attached to the back of a phone with a self-adhesive magnetic ring. They are available in two styles: Duck and Avocado. Both styles have an outer surface of of man-made textile material. The approximate dimensions are 7.0” deep x 3.75” width x 1.0” thick. They are designed to organize, store, protect, and carry identification cards, bank cards, business cards, cash and small belongings.

subject: adult coloring book
description: Product information and photos were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is an adult coloring book. The book will consist of 50 black line art illustrations for coloring. The images provided are moderately detailed home and garden illustrations. The import value of each book will be less than $5.00.

subject: Indian-style dumplings
description: An ingredients breakdown, narrative description of the manufacturing process, and pictures of the product packaging accompanied your inquiry. The subject merchandise is described as three varieties of Indian-style dumplings. The products are imported frozen, in sealed plastic packaging with a net weight between 45.85 and 58.12 ounces, depending on the variety. Instructions provided direct the consumer to heat the products via steaming, air frying, or microwaving. The first product, “Corn and Cheese Momo,” contains a wrapper portion that is comprised of maida, corn starch, water, hydrogenated vegetable fat, and a flour treatment agent (INS  (i)). The filling portion consists of sweet corn, cheese block, melted cheese, capsicum green, red capsicum, yellow capsicum, butter, refined sunflower oil, and corn cheese premix (INS 627 & 631).

subject: fermented black garlic bulbs
description: An ingredients breakdown, description of the manufacturing process, manufacturing flowchart, and a pictures of the product accompanied your letter. The product, “Dehydrated Black Garlic,” is described as fresh, whole garlic bulbs, containing no additional additives, sugar, water or preservatives, that undergo a multi-step manufacturing process in which the raw material undergoes an enzymatic hydrolysis and Maillard browning reaction. The black garlic bulbs are intended for human consumption for use as a snack and will be imported in a refrigerated condition in food-grade nylon vacuum pouches, sealed airtight within an industrial vacuum packaging machine to block oxidation and extend shelf life up to 12 months. The black garlic bulbs are said to be manufactured by first harvesting fresh, raw garlic bulbs and transporting them to the food processing plant.

subject: carry case
description: You have submitted photographs and product descriptions for our review. The article at issue is a fitted carry case specifically designed for the Neuro 20 PRO system. The Neuro 20 PRO system consists of a Smart Suit, control box, tablet, and software. The Smart Suit delivers electrical neuromuscular stimulation to recreate functional movement patterns for treating neurological injuries or diseases. By delivering biphasic electrical currents that closely replicate voluntary muscle firing patterns, the system helps establish muscle memory, coordination, and supports neuroplasticity. Stimulation of both upper and lower extremities, as well as core muscles, enhances sensory feedback, position awareness, and muscle activation timing. The case is imported empty and separately from the device. The case is constructed with an outer surface of man-made textile materials.

subject: coin purse
description: The merchandise under consideration is a coin purse, style number 991195503, measuring approximately 10.5 centimeters high by 14 centimeters wide. The article features a zipper closure at the top and no interior pockets or compartments. The back outer surface is composed of 100% polyester satin. The front outer surface is completely covered with a combination of plastic sequins and glass beads. The glass beads are arranged in the center to depict a design of two martini glasses with olives. The remaining background surface is covered with plastic sequins, and the edging is finished with black glass beads.

subject: framed sunroof glass assemblies
description: The articles under consideration are framed sunroof glass assemblies that are installed in the roof of a motor vehicle and function as moveable or fixed roof windows. Part number 916047JA0A (Product Name GLASS ASSY-SUNROOF, RR) consists of a glass, frame, bracket, and weatherstrip. Part numbers 916046CT1B (Product Name GLASS ASSY-SUNROOF, RR) and 916026CT1B (Product Name GLASS ASSY-SUNROOF, FR) consists of a glass, frame, and weatherstrip. Part number 912057JA0A (Product Name SUNROOF COMPL-SLIDE) is a complete sunroof, which consists of a glass, frame, rail, weatherstrip, and motor. The glass panel is permanently fitted within a frame that provides structural support and facilitates installation, sealing, and integration with the vehicle’s sunroof mechanism.

subject: Frozen Shrimp Spring Roll
description: Ltd. (El Monte, CA). You provided an ingredient breakdown, a description of the manufacturing process, and photographs for the product with your submission. The subject merchandise is Frozen Shrimp Spring Rolls. The product consists of a shrimp and vegetable filling enclosed in a rice flour wrapper. The filling contains shrimp (Penaeus vannamei, 44.45 percent), rice flour, water, bamboo shoots, water chestnuts, shiitake mushrooms, potato starch, chives, sugar, spring onions, sesame oil, ginger, salt, monosodium glutamate, and white pepper. Each spring roll weighs approximately 35 grams and is individually formed, quick-frozen, and packaged in airtight retail trays containing 20 pieces. The product is imported in a frozen state, requires cooking prior to consumption, and is intended for sale to the foodservice industry as an appetizer or snack.

subject: plastic cartridge
description: Images were provided in lieu of a sample. The product under consideration is described as a molded plastic cartridge. It consists of two parts, a hollow cylindrical barrel with a capacity of 100 milliliters and a fitted plunger that slides within the barrel. The barrel is made of plastic, and the plunger is made of plastic with a rubber tip. It will be used as a material reservoir and dispensing cartridge in an additive-manufacturing (3D printing) system that produces objects by semi-solid extrusion. In operation, the cartridge is filled with a printing paste and mounted in the printer, where a mechanical drive advances the plunger to extrude the paste through the barrel opening in controlled amounts. You indicate it has no needle, no needle mount, and while it is sterilized, it is not for medical use. We note that this “cartridge” is a graduated syringe.

subject: multi-function automatic industrial sewing machine
description: This product in question is the Richpeace Automatic Perforation, Embroidery and Sewing (Rotating Head) Machine, model number RPCE-L-SP+E+S-1-1200X800-B-SP6+F9+IS2-VR1, VR2-LH50, RH360, AO, 3P220. This programmable, industrial CNC workstation is designed to sew, embroider, and perforate (punch) automotive interior components, primarily of leather, including steering wheel covers, seat upholstery, dashboards, door panels and other trim. The machine’s working area (X and Y axis) measures ×800 mm. You state that the machine is not intended for general textile production. The machine includes a bridge-style frame, and features automatic programmable sewing using a 360-degree rotary sewing head, a 9-needle embroidery head for decorative stitching, and a 6-pin rotary perforation system to punch and create ornamentation and decorative patterns.

subject: N-Phenyl-N-(trichloromethylsulfenyl)-benzenesulfonamide (CAS No. 2280-49-1)
description: The instant merchandise is N-Phenyl-N-(trichloromethylsulfenyl)-benzenesulfonamide. It has the product name of “Safic-Chem REC” Safic-Chem REC is described as a medical intermediate and rubber vulcanizing agent. It will be imported in bulk as a dry powder in combination with calcium carbonate, and hydrotreated heavy paraffinic distillate (petroleum), which you describe as functioning, respectively, as a stabilizer, and dedusting agent.

subject: Frozen Potato Shrimp
description: Ltd. (El Monte, CA). You provided an ingredients breakdown, description of manufacturing process, and photographs with your submitted letter. The subject merchandise is a Frozen Pre-Fried Potato Shrimp. The product consists of individually formed frozen shrimp appetizers featuring a coating of shredded potato. Each piece is made by wrapping strips of potato around a shrimp filling, creating a textured potato exterior. The product is composed of potato, shrimp (Penaeus vannamei - 36.5 percent), tapioca starch, palm oil, sugar, soybean protein, salt, spring onion, yeast extract, and pepper. Each appetizer weighs approximately 30 grams and is individually quick frozen (IQF) before being packed in airtight retail trays containing ten pieces.

subject: electrostatic discharge (ESD) suppressors from the Philippines
description: The merchandise under consideration in this request are three versions of Littelfuse ESD suppressors, identified individually as model numbers AXGD1, PGB1, and XGD. All three models are described as one-channel, bidirectional polymer ESD protection devices designed for sensitive electronic equipment and high-speed dataline applications. In use, the devices are surface mounted within electronic assemblies or circuit board assemblies to suppress fast-rising electrostatic discharge transients while preserving signal integrity and minimalizing data loss. All models are rated at a maximum DC voltage of 24V.

subject: semi-finished airbag inflator tubes
description: The articles under consideration are semi-finished airbag inflator tubes, Part Numbers CTL_T921A, CTL_V910A, CTL_V677A, CTL_V678A, CTL_R671A, CTL_V690D, and CTL_C255B. They each consist of a seamless steel tube that is cut to a specified length and incorporates an inner chamfer at each end. The tube has an outside diameter ranging from 20 mm to 40 mm and is manufactured for further processing into an automotive airbag inflator. Each end is chamfered specifically to match its corresponding mating component on the inflator.

subject: Solid Processor
description: The merchandise is identified as the Solid Processor (Model OLO RT-500 US1), which you describe as follows: The Solid Processor is an electrically driven, fully automatic, residential electric heating (induction heating) appliance designed for use in individual residential households. It is permanently installed outdoors on the property of a single-family residence and receives small quantities of dewatered sludge generated by an on-site domestic sewage treatment system, converting the sludge into sterile mineral residue (ash) through drying and induction heating technology. The residue is collected in a removable tray and emptied approximately twice per year. The Solid Processor consists of a freestanding upright cabinet, to be permanently installed outdoors on a single-family residential property via a support frame, that contains the components.

subject: Casablanca stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Casablanca stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. Casablanca is an ivory-colored stone with gray and black mottling and streaks. From the information you provided, it will measure between 115 to 122 inches in length, between 65 to 75 inches in width, and either 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches in thickness. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for such applications as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and surfaces for office furniture. Laboratory analysis has determined that Casablanca is an igneous stone comprised predominantly of quartz and alkali feldspars, and meets the geological definition of granite.

subject: zinc alloy ring from the Netherlands
description: The merchandise under consideration is identified as a ring made of a die-cast zinc alloy. The images in your submission illustrate that the zinc alloy ring is a C-shaped, circular ring with a distinct raised flange running along the outer circumference and features cutouts/notches. You state that the zinc alloy ring is a purely mechanical metal component designed for use solely with the electric toothbrush. It is imported as a standalone mechanical component, without any electronic elements.

subject: Snowfall stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Snowfall stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. Snowfall is an ivory and cream-colored stone with amber and black streaks. From the information you provided, it will measure between 115 to 122 inches in length, between 65 to 75 inches in width, and either 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches in thickness. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for applications such as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and surfaces for office furniture. Laboratory analysis has determined that Snowfall is comprised of granite. The top of the stone has been polished and the edges have been beveled.

subject: Super Black stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Super Black stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. Super Black is a black stone with light gray veining and flecks. From the information you provided, Super Black measures approximately 3 meters high by 2 meters long and is either 2 or 3 centimeters thick. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for applications such as countertops, wall cladding, surfaces, and flooring. Laboratory analysis has determined that Super Black is gabbro. The top and sides are polished, and the edges are beveled.

subject: silt fence with wooden stakes
description: In lieu of a sample, photographs and videos were provided with your request. The item, described as a “pocket silt fence with stakes,” consisting of geotextile fabric and 17 wooden stakes is intended to be used at construction sites to prevent sediment or soil runoff during rain. The geotextile fabric is composed of 100 percent polypropylene (PP) woven dyed black strips. The PP strips measure approximately 1.59 to 2.

subject: DIY Acrylic Painting Kit
description: In your submission, the subject product is identified as a DIY Acrylic Painting Kit. This activity kit is intended for all ages and is imported in a condition suitable for retail sale. The kit is comprised of five acrylic paint pods in assorted colors, two paint brushes, one clear acrylic sheet, one sheet of paper with a printed image, and one small wooden stand. All of the kit’s components are intended to be used together to creatively paint and display the acrylic sheet. The Explanatory Notes to the Harmonized Tariff System, although not legally binding, provide guidance in the interpretation of the Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System at the international level.

subject: White Delicatus stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as White Delicatus stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. White Delicatus is a white, cream, and light gray stone with black streaks and dark reddish-brown flecks. From the information you provided, it will measure approximately 2 meters long by 3 meters high and either 2 or 3 centimeters in thickness. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for both indoor and outdoor use in such applications as countertops, wall cladding, surfaces, and flooring. Laboratory analysis has determined that White Delicatus is an igneous rock comprised of quartz and albite. The top and sides are polished and the edges are beveled.

subject: metal costume
description: Informational material was submitted with your request. The item under consideration is a custom-made metal renaissance fair costume resembling armor worn by a female warrior. There are two articles that make up this costume, a top chest piece and a bottom skirt both made of individual aluminum pieces that include scalemail resembling animal scales and rings similar to chainmail armor. Both articles are held together with rings when assembled as a whole. The chest piece is assembled with scalemail along the front and uses chainmail along the back to form straps for it to be worn, and the skirt has two scalemail assemblies on the front and back which are hung from a chainmail belt worn from the waist down. We note that some components of this costume are composed of more than one metal.

subject: LED Glass Decorative Cylinders
description: The merchandise under consideration consists of two decorative glass cylinders, identified as item numbers 866042 and 866041. The cylinders are identical in design but one is colored red and the other green. The items are made of high borosilicate glass. The glass features a design of trees and snowflakes and contains an internal LED that enhances the decorative appeal of the items but does not provide significant lighting to an area or room. You indicated in your letter that the unit value of the items is $3.65 each. The glass is not glass-ceramic, lead crystal, or pressed and toughened (specially tempered), nor is it cut, engraved, crystalline, or non-lead crystal.

subject: Istanbul stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Istanbul stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. Istanbul is an ivory, cream, and gray stone with amber streaks. From the information you provided, it will measure approximately 2 meters long by 3 meters high and either 2 or 3 centimeters in thickness. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for both indoor and outdoor use in such applications as countertops, wall cladding, surfaces, and flooring. Laboratory analysis has determined that Istanbul is comprised of granite. The top and sides are polished and the edges are beveled.

subject: LED Glass Tree
description: The merchandise under consideration is an evergreen tree-shaped decorative article, identified as item number 865735. The article is made of high borosilicate glass and measures approximately 10 inches high by 4.7 inches wide by 3.5 inches deep. The glass material is golden in color. The item features internal LEDs which, when switched on, provide a soft, gentle glow, enhancing the decorative effect of the article. You indicated in your letter that the unit value of the item is $5.00 each. The glass is not glass-ceramic, lead crystal, or pressed and toughened (specially tempered).

subject: wall mounted iron hanging sign brackets
description: Photographs and product descriptions of two different sizes of Iron Sign Brackets were submitted with your inquiry. Each L-shaped bracket consists of 1/8” cut steel sheet with two predrilled holes to form the wall mounting side, a ½” square iron bar with a cast iron ornamental tip projecting lengthwise, and a steel flat bar with decorative steel curls positioned diagonally within the L shape. Two small steel flat bar hangers each with a predrilled hole hang from the projecting square bar for attaching a hanging sign. The brackets measure 10” x 24” or 8” x 14”. These iron hanging sign brackets are designed to be permanently affixed vertically to a wall or flat surface and to project from that surface to support the weight of hanging sign.

subject: tote bag
description: You have submitted photographs and product descriptions for our review. The product at issue, which you have assigned product name Baccharis, is a tote bag constructed of genuine bovine leather. It is designed and sized to provide storage, protection, portability, and organization to personal effects such as books, small clothing articles, and water bottles. It measures approximately 14 inches high by 12.5 inches wide x 6 inches deep. It features an open top and two shoulder straps.

subject: wallpapers
description: Product information and samples were submitted for our review. The products under consideration are wallcoverings constructed of a sheet of textured vinyl adhered to a paper backing. This ruling addresses only Styles 140D and 150E. The wallcoverings are imported in rolls from 50 to  yards, and the width of each is 137cm.

subject: decorative owl figure
description: Product information and photos were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is Item 865858, a decorative owl figure. The form of the figure is constructed of Styrofoam, and the form is covered with multiple materials. The eyes (the most prominent feature) of the owl are surrounded by natural, unspun sisal fibers. The belly of the owl is also covered with sisal fibers. The whole of the head (approximately 50 percent of the surface are of the figure) is covered with fine strands of cattails. The wings and tail feathers are made of a combination of birch wood twig slices, straw, and banana leaf. The owl is perched on a wooden twig with a pine cone and plastic pine needles, and it has plastic eyes.

subject: lock-valve spring retainer
description: The item under consideration is a lock-valve spring retainer (Part # 22223-2A800) which you state is a collet-type component consisting of two semi-circular pieces, intended for use in the valve train of a vehicular gasoline (spark-ignition) engine. The function of this component is to secure the valve spring retainer to the valve stem, allowing the valve spring, retainer, and valve to operate together as an integrated assembly.

subject: aluminum cups
description: A photograph and product descriptions were submitted for our review. The merchandise under consideration is identified as Hefty 20 oz. Aluminum Cups. You have indicated that the cups are made of a 0.18 mm aluminum alloy with a polypropylene coating outside and a polypropylene lining inside. They are designed for kitchen and food service establishments. Each cup measures approximately 125 millimeters high, with an open-top diameter of approximately 98 millimeters, and a base of approximately 73 millimeters in diameter.

subject: epoxy resin key chain making kit
description: Item/SKU DM0030003 is an Epoxy Resin “Create Your Own Keychain” kit. A sample of the kit was provided with your submission. The kit is comprised of a clear liquid two-component epoxy resin AB (resin plus hardener), 2 silicone molds, 3 packets of colored glitter, 2 bottles of pigment, 2 stirring rods, 2 mixing cups, 2 droppers, 5 metal open jump rings and 5 metal keychains. The Epoxy Resin “Create Your Own Keychain” kit is considered a set for retail sale based on GRI 3(b) with the essential character imparted by the epoxy resin.

subject: “Squishy Cloud Buddies”
description: Photographs and product descriptions of the “Squishy Cloud Buddies” were submitted with your inquiry. The “Squishy Cloud Buddies,” SKU# , come in three character shapes: bunny, carrot, and chick, each measuring approximately 13 inches long by 3.75 inches wide. The product’s exterior is composed of thermoplastic rubber and has a polyvinyl alcohol filling making the item very soft, pliable, and stretchy. Children experience manipulative play by squeezing, stretching, compressing, and tossing the “Squishy Cloud Buddies.” The “Squishy Cloud Buddies” are principally designed for the amusement of children 3 years of age and older.

subject: polyvinyl chloride (PVC) single-hung window system
description: Product SKU: IGZ-82-SH--EGR, 82 Series Single-Hung Window System, egress configuration, is a vertically sliding, single-hung window. It is comprised of a frame extruded from unplasticized PVC and reinforced with steel segments, and incorporating a 19 mm insulated glass unit (IGU). It will be imported with all the required hardware and weather seals.

subject: leather boot upper from the Dominican Republic
description: A sample, a description of the manufacturing process, and photographs were submitted with your request. The submitted photographs and description for Item#  depict a woman’s closed-toe, closed-heel, work boot style, casual, boot upper constructed from sewn together leather pieces. The shaft of the boot upper extends above the ankle and has five pairs of metal eyelets over the forefoot and four pairs of metal hooks that facilitate a lace closure. It is fully shaped and sewn to a midsole. A circular hole, stated to be larger than a nickel, is punched completely through the heel area of the upper’s bottom. You state the boot upper is manufactured in the Dominican Republic.

subject: used excavator
description: The merchandise under consideration is a used Yanmar self-propelled mini hydraulic excavator, model number Vio45-6A. The excavator has a mechanical arm engineered for a backhoe bucket attachment, a mini dozer blade, and an operator cab with an open canopy. The upper structure, which includes the operator cab and mechanical arm, can rotate 360 degrees and is mounted on a rubber track undercarriage. The excavator has a maximum digging force of 3,220 kilograms, a maximum digging depth of 3,740 millimeters, and an operating weight of 4,800 kilograms.

subject: White Ice stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as White Ice stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. White Ice is an off-white stone with light gray to charcoal gray mottling. From the information you provided, it will measure between 115 to 122 inches in length, between 65 to 75 inches in width, and either 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches in thickness. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for such applications as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and surfaces for office furniture. Laboratory analysis has determined that White Ice is an other igneous rock comprised predominantly of quartz and plagioclase feldspars. The top and sides are polished and the edges are beveled.

subject: Bahamas White stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Bahamas White stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. Bahamas White is an ivory-colored stone with gray and black streaks. From the information you provided, Bahamas White measures approximately 3 meters high by 2 meters long and is either 2 or 3 centimeters thick. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for applications such as countertops, wall cladding, surfaces, and flooring. Laboratory analysis has determined that Bahamas White is a metamorphic stone. The top and sides are polished, and the edges are beveled.

subject: load wheel assembly
description: , located in Marlboro, New Jersey. The article under consideration is a heavy-duty load wheel assembly (Part/Style No. BDS3-WHEELASY-P) that you state is a dedicated component in industrial load-moving dollies. The item is comprised of a non-marking, black cast polyurethane tread (95 Shore A hardness) molded over a solid steel core center, which is fitted internally with two steel 6204ZZ precision radial ball bearings. It measures 82 mm (3.23 inches) in diameter and 48 mm (1.89 inches) in width.

subject: Pantoprazole Sodium Tablets in dosage form,
description: Pantoprazole Sodium, imported in 20 mg, and 40 mg delayed-release tablets, belongs to a class of medications called proton pump inhibitors (PPIs). It is indicated for the treatment of erosive esophagitis, gastric acid hypersecretion, and to promote healing of tissue damage caused by gastric acid.

subject: women’s suit-type jacket from the Philippines
description: Your sample will be returned as you requested. Style 274224 is a women’s upper body garment constructed from 100 percent polyester knit fabric. It is constructed from four panels sewn together lengthwise and features a right-over-left, full front opening with four button closures, which are reinforced with knotted thread and smaller buttons on the garment’s inner surface; a self-fabric spread collar with curved edges; long, hemmed sleeves; two patch pockets on the front panels below the waist; a center back seam flanked by two two-inch-long vertical tack stitches that extend down from the back neckline; and a straight, hemmed bottom. The body and sleeves are lined with 100 percent polyester woven fabric.

subject: aluminum automotive component
description: The article under consideration is a slide rail assembly installed on the pickup truck cargo box side walls, designed specifically for the Nissan H61P pickup truck. The product named CHANNEL ASSY-SIDE RR (Part number 93396 9BS0A) is an integrated slide rail track for adjustable cargo hooks. It serves to provide in-transit cargo protection by incorporating a mounting track system for removeable cargo hooks, enabling the adjusting positioning of cargo hooks, and when used in conjunction with hooks and ropes, creates a cargo restraint system. The slide rail is made of AA -BE T6, an architectural aluminum alloy. The product features ridges, internal channels, grooves, and pre-drilled holes that are unique to the Nissan H61P chassis dimensions. It is bolted to the side walls of the cargo box on the truck.

subject: motherboard
description: The merchandise under consideration is identified as the Sixunited STHT1 – AMD AI Max+ 395 Thin Mini ITX Motherboard. The subject device is comprised of a printed circuit board (PCB) upon which is mounted an AMD accelerated processing unit (APU) as the critical component. This APU integrates a central processing unit (CPU) and a graphics processing unit (GPU) into a single semiconductor device. Additionally, the PCB incorporates 32GB of memory, network interface controllers, storage interface connectors, power management circuity, and various other connection points for expansion. The subject motherboard will be used as the central computing component within computers and data servers in various applications such as gaming, graphics processing, and artificial intelligence.

subject: decorative hedgehog figure
description: Product information and photos were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is Item 865823, a decorative hedgehog figure. You do not provide the dimensions of the figure. The form of the figure is constructed of Styrofoam, and the form is covered with multiple materials. The front of the hedgehog (approximately 40 percent) is covered with natural, unspun sisal fibers. The remaining portion of the hedgehog is covered with an equally distributed mix of materials, including natural tree cones, natural leaves, natural wood chips, and plastic twigs (plastic monofilaments) that are more than 1mm in diameter.

subject: stainless-steel vacuum vessel
description: Photographs and a sample was submitted and sent to the Customs laboratory for analysis. The merchandise is a stainless-steel water bottle. You indicate that the item is a double-walled vacuum drinking vessel. The stainless-steel water bottle measures approximately 25 centimeters high and has a diameter of 7.2 centimeters. The water bottle has a white stainless-steel exterior with a flat bottom, a bamboo screw-top cap, and a swiveling stainless steel handle connected to the top cap. On the exterior of the water bottle, are printed with the words “National Geographic,” “Expeditions,” “Lindblad,” and the logo.
