The drinking vessel is designed to keep beverages at a fairly constant temperature for reasonable periods of time. The volume capacity is 600 milliliters.

subject: leather notebook cover
description: No sample was provided; however, photographs were provided. The handmade refillable notebook cover consists of a single piece of leather folded to form a protective cover. The cover is constructed from bovine leather. It is designed for long-term use and to hold a removable notebook insert by means of elastic cords.

subject: rotor core
description: The merchandise under consideration is described as laminated rotor core identified by part number 38220980, which is a rotor assembly specifically designed for use with electric power steering motor. The rotor assembly consists of stacked, round silicon steel laminations forming a solid core. The assembly incorporates twelve permanent magnets securely embedded within the internal core slots.

subject: laminated textile fabric
description: “A00007/201/403 - Blocker FR3 - 155 GSM” is a laminated textile said to be imported in a finished state from France. The fabric is a three-layer laminated product with a woven face fabric composed of man-made fibers, a flame-resistant polyurethane membrane and a polyurethane adhesive. The plastic accounts for approximately 32 percent of the weight of the fabric. The total fabric weight is said to be 155 g/m2 and the fabric is designed for use as a moisture barrier or outer shell layer in protective clothing for firefighters.

subject: polyester and cotton staple yarn
description: A sample of the yarn was provided with your request. The sample was sent for laboratory analysis and will be retained for reference purposes. The subject article, which you state does not have a SKU#, is described as “30/1 (Ne) 50% Cotton and 50% Spun Polyester – Carded Ring Spun Yarn.” You state that the yarn will be used for the commercial knitting of circular knit fabrics, such as t-shirts. The country of origin is Indonesia. The U.S. Customs and Border Protection Laboratory (CBP Laboratory) analysis has confirmed that the sample is a single yarn composed of an intimate blend of staple cotton and polyester fibers, containing 51.7 percent polyester and 48.3 percent cotton, with a metric count of 50.3. The sample is not textured, not elastomeric, and is not coated, covered, laminated, or impregnated with plastic material.

subject: Fabric Refresher Spray
description: In your submission, the subject product is identified as Fabric Refresher Spray. It is described as a surface- active auxiliary washing preparation for textile substrates. It contains an organic nonionic surfactant (Laureth -3) and a chemical neutralizer to penetrate fibers, emulsify soils, and eliminate odors within the fabric matrix. This product will be imported in 22 FL OZ retail-ready plastic spray bottles. You state that there is specific chemical synergy between two primary components of the product’s chemical mixture: Laureth-3 and Sodium Bicarbonate. Laureth-3 is a non-ionic surface-active agent, which serves as the primary vehicle for this preparation. This surfactant actively reduces the surface tension of the aqueous solution. This mechanical reduction allows the liquid preparation to deeply wet and penetrate the tight, porous weave of textile or carpet fibers.

subject: stone paper corrugated boxes
description: The products under consideration are described as stone paper corrugated boxes. You state that the stone paper boxes contain 70 to 80 percent by weight calcium carbonate and 20 to 30 percent by weight polyethylene. The stone paper corrugated boxes are designed and used to package and ship various goods.

subject: decorative paper clip
description: An image was provided in lieu of a sample. The article under consideration is described as a decorative paper clip. It measures two inches in length by one inch in width and is formed from gold-colored zinc alloy wire into the traditional paper clip configuration. Three removable zinc alloy charms, including a star, a flower, and a butterfly, are attached to the outer loop of the paper clip by small metal jump rings. The charm designs may vary and will be comprised of zinc alloy or plastic depending on the design. Your submission states that the paper clip is designed and marketed as a decorative stationery accessory and that the attached charms do not alter its functionality.

subject: deadend connectors
description: There are four items under consideration with this request, which are all identified as deadend connectors for use in high voltage overhead power transmission or distribution systems and are individually identified as (Item 1) Aluminum Bolted Deadend with Stirrup Clamp (Model No. ADES70N) (“the Stirrup Model”); (Item 2) Straight Line, Spring-Loaded, Side-Opening Aluminum Bolted Deadend (Model No. ADEZ116N) (“the Spring-Loaded Model”); (Item 3) Straight Line, Strain Clamp Aluminum Bolted Deadend (Model No. ADS88N) (“the Aluminum Model”); and (Item 4) Aluminum Quadrant Strain Clamp Bolted Deadend (Model No. SD185N) (“the Quadrant Model”). Item 1, the Stirrup Model, is used with distribution conductors made of aluminum, steel reinforced aluminum, or aluminum alloy. It includes two U-bolts which are used to secure conductors in place to make an electrical connection.

subject: paper party decoration
description: , LLC. You have submitted photographs and a detailed description of an item identified as a paper chain garland, item number 45534701, which consists of 48 strips of paper in eight bright colors, each measuring approximately 11.02” by 1.57”. The purchaser may assemble these strips into a paper chain garland measuring approximately 13’. Each strip features features pre-cut notches allowing the purchaser to simply interlock and clip the strips together without any additional tape, glue or fasteners. The item is flat packed in a transparent polybag with a printed header card. The flimsy paper decoration is marketed and sold as a single-use party decoration.

subject: empty aluminum electrical cabinet
description: The merchandise under consideration is an empty aluminum electrical cabinet identified by part number 860658054, which is described as an aluminum cabinet designed to house and protect electrical components that are added after importation such as power distribution equipment, fiber optic equipment, and other electrical equipment.

subject: intake manifold gasket
description: The under consideration is an intake manifold gasket, part number 558436, which you state is used between the intake manifold and the cylinder head to provide a seal, prevent the intake of ambient air, and leakage of internal fluids. You state that the gasket is composed of 100% FKM rubber. FKM, also called fluoroelastomer or fluorine rubber, is a family of synthetic rubbers.

subject: Desert Atlas stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Desert Atlas stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. Desert Atlas is an ivory-colored stone with patches of olive, dark green, and amber, as well as dark green veining and streaks. From the information you provided, the top surface area of Desert Atlas measures approximately 6 square meters, and it is 3 centimeters thick. After importation it will be cut to size and shape for applications such as countertops and tables. Laboratory analysis has determined that Desert Atlas is an igneous stone which contains almost no quartz. The top is honed and the sides are simply cut or sawn.

subject: surfaced, edge-glued lumber
description: Product information and photos were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is a multilayer wood panel. The panel measures approximately  mm x  mm x 18 mm. It consists of three layers: a core of edge-glued lumber that is surfaced on either side with medium density fiberboard (MDF). The edge-glued lumber consists either of spruce/pine/fir (SPF) (a coniferous wood), or Falcataria moluccana (a tropical wood), and measures 13 mm in thickness. The MDF measures approximately 3 mm in thickness on the face and the back of the edge-glued lumber. From the pictures provided, it appears that the MDF is also covered with a paper layer printed with wood grain. The panel is not considered plywood, veneered panels, or similar laminated wood, as it does not consist of multiple layers of whole wood. The MDF is considered a surface covering, as is the printed paper layer.

subject: two decorative headbands
description: Images were provided in lieu of a sample. The articles under consideration are two decorative headbands. Both consist of a semi-rigid metal horseshoe-shaped frame covered entirely with a black woven polyester fabric. One headband features a large black polyester bow with a grosgrain finish, while the other features a black veil made of polyester tulle netting with small plastic embellishments in the shape of stars. Per your correspondence, the two headbands will be imported and sold together.

subject: casava flatbread
description: An ingredients breakdown, nutrition label, and photos of the product accompanied your inquiry. The “Yukan One Ingredient Pizza Crust” is described as a thin, circular, casava based flatbread which is intended to be used as a base for gluten free pizza preparations, bread alternatives and meal accompaniments. The product is composed of 100 percent casava (manioc) root and is sold in retail packaging consisting of ten flatbreads with a net weight of 850 grams (1.8 pounds), each individual flatbread is approximately 10 inches (25.4 centimeters) in diameter. Production of the flatbread begins with the washing, peeling, grating, and pressing of fresh cassava roots. The cassava is then formed into circular flatbreads and baked until fully cooked and dried. You state no additional ingredients, preservatives, additives, or processing aids are added during the manufacturing process.

subject: men’s jacket
description: Your sample will be returned as requested. Style LD- is a men’s jacket constructed from both knit and woven components. The hood, sleeves, back yoke, and the shoulders, are constructed from 100% polyamide woven fabric. The balance of the garment is constructed from 82% polyester, and 18% elastane knit fabric. The hood and sleeves are removable and attached at the shoulders by means of zipper closures. The garment features a hood, full frontal opening secured with zipper closures, round neckline, long sleeves with thumb holes and an elasticized binding tape at the cuffs, pockets below the waist secured by zipper closures, and the garment bottom is bound with an elasticized binding tape. Neither the knit fabric nor the woven fabric exceeds 60% of the garment’s visible surface area. Moreover, neither fabric imparts the essential character of the garment.

subject: plastic wall mount bracket
description: Part number 117832 is an acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene (ABS) plastic wall mount bracket. The bracket is designed to be mounted on a wall to mount/hold a WiFi router.

subject: pillow cover
description: In lieu of a sample, photographs of an assortment of pillow covers were provided. The subject merchandise, described as the “KB Printed Pillow Cover 18/18,” is a decorative pillow cover measuring 18 x 18 inches. The pillow cover is composed of 100 percent polyester woven fabric. The face of the cover includes multi-colored printing with an underwater manatee (sea cow) design. The back is printed in solid blue. The cover features an envelope-style closure on the back. You state, while this specific model features a solid printed back, other designs within this product line utilize a printed design on the back panels to coordinate with the design on the front.

subject: amphibious off-road all-terrain vehicle (ATV)
description: The item under consideration, identified as the “SHERP N1200,” is an amphibious all-terrain vehicle that you state is designed for off-road use in commercial, industrial, agricultural, environmental, and scientific operations. You state that this model is commonly used to transport personnel, tools, materials, and supplies across challenging terrain, including swamps, muskeg, marshes, snow, ice, sand, flood conditions, and open water. The vehicle’s amphibious capability enables transportation across terrain inaccessible to conventional wheeled vehicles but does not alter its principal function as a vehicle for the transport of goods. The SHERP has the following features: 1.8 liter, 3-cylinder diesel engine 55 Horsepower 2,640 lb. payload (1.1 metric tons) Standard 2-passenger seating Towing Capacity 5,170 lbs.

subject: industrial push broom
description: Images and product literature were provided in lieu of a sample. The product under consideration is described as the “Actisweep Industrial Push Broom with Bristle Segments.” It is a heavy-duty, non-motorized mechanical sweeping device designed to be mounted onto a motorized host vehicle, such as a forklift, agricultural tractor, or telehandler, for intensive industrial-grade indoor and outdoor cleaning operations. The broom is comprised of a rectangular steel frame, a brush system that features multiple rows of high-density polypropylene (PP) fiber bristles, and a hitch system, which is a heavy mechanical interface made of galvanized steel that is bolted or fastened to the top of the steel frame and is interchangeable depending on the user’s host vehicle.

subject: Zurich stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Zurich stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. Zurich is an ivory-colored stone with brown mottling and streaks. From the information you provided, it will measure approximately 300 centimeters wide by 200 centimeters long and either 2 or 3 centimeters thick. After importation, the stone will be cut to size and shape for both indoor and outdoor use in such applications as countertops, wall cladding, surfaces, and flooring. Laboratory analysis has determined that Zurich is an igneous stone comprised predominantly of quartz and alkali feldspars, and meets the geological definition of granite. The top and sides of the stone have been polished and the edges have been beveled.

subject: aquarium sea salt synthetic preparation
description: You describe the instant merchandise as a synthetic reef aquarium salt compound. It appears to be comprised of food grade sodium chloride, anhydrous sodium sulfate, anhydrous magnesium sulfate, magnesium chloride hexahydrate, potassium chloride, calcium chloride dihydrate, and other compounds in trace amounts.

subject: ethernet cables
description: The merchandise under consideration is identified as the Solid Plenum Cat6 cable with is described as a gigabit ethernet data cable which is commonly used for structured cabling projects such as vertical, horizontal, or backbone systems. The cable is internally constructed of 23 AWG copper wire insulated with FEP. Two color matched conductors are twisted together to form a pair, and four pairs are assembled to form a core. The core is jacked with a low smoke flame retardant PVC. The cables are imported on reels to be cut to the desired length by the end user and are not terminated with any connectors. The rated voltage of the cables is stated to be 48 volts. In use, the cables transmit data and other information within various installation scenarios.

subject: clutch release bearing
description: A sample was provided with your submission and will be retained per your request. The article under consideration is a clutch release bearing, part RCB621, used in an automotive clutch. You state that when the clutch pedal is depressed, the bearing moves toward the flywheel through the force of the clutch release lever, which pushes in the pressure plate’s release fingers. This action moves the pressure plate away from the clutch disc which interrupts the engine flow and allows the gear to be shifted.

subject: singlet
description: Your sample will be retained by this office. Style 912222 is a woman’s singlet constructed from 87% polyamide and 13% elastane lace-like mesh knit fabric. The undergarment features a V-neckline, a shelf bra, and elastic, adjustable shoulder straps.

subject: plastic laundry bin
description: A photograph of the item was submitted along with your request. The item concerned is a white plastic laundry bin, item number GS750. It measures approximately 17.72 inches in length, 14.57 inches in width, and 22.64 inches in height. It is made of 100% polypropylene (PP) plastic material. The laundry bin consists of a perforated plastic body frame, a hinged lid, and integrated side openings that serve as carrying handles. The article is designed to be used in the home to hold and store assorted items such as laundry, toys, and other household items.

subject: floating hull protectors from the United Kingdom
description: Product information was submitted with your request. The items under consideration are five models of floating hull protectors. They are described as floating structures designed to reduce marine growth on submerged hull surfaces by limiting water contact and movement. During use, the hull protectors are positioned on the water’s surface and secured to a marina berth with mooring lines. A vessel is then guided onto the floating protector’s upper surface where it will remain stationary. Once the vessel is positioned, standing water is routed away from the hull while outer bumpers stop additional water from entering the area. Based on the submitted information, the floating hull protectors primarily consist of reinforced, marine-grade polyvinyl chloride (PVC) materials, buoyant closed-cell foam, and laminated low-density polyethylene (LDPE) bubble material.

subject: axle speed sensor
description: The merchandise under consideration is identified as the ZTR AxleGen, which is further described as a locomotive axle generator. The subject device is comprised of a magnetic or optical encoder attached to a shaft withing a metal housing. The generator is attached to the wheelset of a locomotive where it creates a magnetic or optical field. As the axle rotates, the field is broken and an electrical impulse is sent to the interface module in the cab of the vehicle. The electrical impulse is translated by the module to interpret the rotational speed of the axles and wheels.

subject: women’s blouses from the Dominican Republic
description: Your submitted sample will be destroyed. Style W61383 is a women’s upper body garment constructed from 84 percent modal, 9 percent cashmere, and 7 percent elastane knit fabric. The outer surface of the garment’s fabric measures more than 10 stitches per linear centimeter in both the horizontal and vertical directions. The loose-fitting garment extends from the shoulders to below the waist and features a round front neckline; short, hemmed sleeves; and a straight, hemmed bottom. Style W64383 is a women’s upper body garment constructed from 84 percent modal, 9 percent cashmere, and 7 percent elastane knit fabric. The outer surface of the garment’s fabric measures more than 10 stitches per linear centimeter in both the horizontal and vertical directions.

subject: “Palo Santo” (Bursera Graveolens) sticks
description: The merchandise under consideration consists of 14 Palo Santo (Bursera Graveolens) sticks, a copper clip, and a textile drawstring bag, packaged for retail sale under the brand name AuraSerenity. You state that the sticks are gathered from naturally fallen trees in Peruvian forests and are aged for several years, during which they are exposed to natural sun and rain conditions, allowing them to develop aromatic resins. The incense sticks are intended for use in aromatic rituals, releasing their scent when burned. The clip is used to hold the stick during burning. The Explanatory Notes of the Harmonized Tariff System provide guidance in the interpretation of the Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System at the international level.

subject: metal furniture from the United Kingdom
description: In lieu of samples, technical and illustrative literature, a product description, and a manufacturing synopsis were provided for review. Item VX , the “VX Bayed Enclosure System,” is a series of floor-standing and unequipped steel storage cabinets that measure approximately 31" in width, 79" in height, and 24” in depth. The cabinets have a single front door, rear panel, roof plate, and a mounting plate. The cabinets are constructed of 1.5mm steel sheet metal and are designed to secure computer server equipment, powder distribution busbars, power cables, power supplies, air-water heat exchangers, chillers, and additional hardware components (sold separately).

subject: diaphragm and bladder pressure tanks
description: The products in question are pressure tanks used in various water pumping systems, including jet pumps, booster pumps, centrifugal pumps, and submersible pumps. The specific pressure vessel models are PWN-US-80LV, PWN-US-18LX, PWN-US-80LH, and SFN-US-325LV, with tank capacities ranging from 4.8 gallons to 85.9 gallons. The tanks have carbon steel exteriors and each includes an internal water chamber and air chamber pre-charged with pressurized air. The two chambers are separated by a flexible butyl rubber internal membrane, i.e., a diaphragm or bladder. The fixed diaphragm model tanks (PWN series) also include a polypropylene liner, and all tanks include water connections fittings, air valves, and an integrated support base. In operation, the tank is pre-charged at the factory with air pressure to create an internal air cushion.

subject: food industry emulsifier
description: A sample was submitted and will be retained for reference purposes. The instant item is described as a food industry emulsifier with the product name of Finamul . Your state Finamul  would be used in conjunction with bakery, non-dairy creamer, and coffee creamer products. CBP Laboratory analysis found that it consisted of sodium stearate, sodium stearoyl mono-lactylate, and sodium stearoyl di-lactylate.

subject: ornamental craft kits
description: Samples were provided and will be retained as requested. There are four craft kits under consideration with each being described as a “diamond keychain kit.” They feature a primary decorative component that the consumer will embellish with crystal diamonds and then will assemble the other kit elements to create the finished charm. The first, item number DS0031003, includes the following components: one decorative acetate plastic piece with the appearance of a candle, two acrylic plastic pieces, one oval clip, one piece of nylon rope, one small metal ring, one tube of white glue, four bags of crystal diamonds, and a tool kit. The second, item number DS0031006, includes the following components: two acetate pieces (one shaped like a dog), one acrylic plastic piece, one steel wire ring, one tube of white glue, four bags of crystal diamonds, and a tool kit.

subject: hair clip kit
description: A sample was provided and will be retained as requested. The product under consideration is described as the hair claw clip craft kit, item DK0069001. It includes the following items: a plastic claw hair clip, two smaller hair clips, two sheets with imitation gemstone stickers, and tweezers. It is intended for the customer to decorate the hairclips with the provided stickers.

subject: underpants
description: Your sample will be retained by this office. Style 948313 is a woman’s undergarment constructed from 98% nylon and 2% elastane lace-like knit mesh fabric. The undergarment features a 100% cotton crotch lining, an exposed elastic waistband, and elasticized leg openings with decorative trim.

subject: cab skirt
description: The article under consideration is a cab skirt, SKU: MD9428, which is used as a direct-fit motor vehicle body component. The product is made of stainless steel and includes integrated light emitting diodes (LED) lighting. The primary function of the article is as an aesthetic cab body part. You state that while this model includes lighting, comparable cab skirts are also produced and sold without lighting, demonstrating that the underlying article exists independently of the lighting feature.

subject: exfoliating cloth
description: A sample of the product was provided to this office and will be retained for training purposes. The imported item is an unfinished facial exfoliating cloth composed of two layers of 100 percent cotton cheesecloth fabric. The two layers of fabric are treated with tannin pre-mordant, cut into 6 x 6-inch squares, and sewn together with an overlock stitch. After importation, a charcoal dye is applied, and a decorative zigzag border stitch is sewn around the edges. The finished product is sold as a facial exfoliating cloth under the Romjay™ brand. The “So Polished Facial Cloth Refill,” SKU R-LE002, is sold at retail with two cloths. The “So Polished Facial Cloth Kit,” SKU K-LE001, is sold at retail with two cloths and a magnetic hanger.

subject: agglomerated slabs
description: The merchandise under consideration consists of two crystalline silica-free agglomerated slabs, identified as Sample  (Frosty Carrina) and Sample  (Fresh Concrete). Representative samples were submitted with your request and were forwarded to the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Laboratory for analysis. You state in your submission that the slabs are engineered for use in the kitchen and bath industry as countertops, vanities, and thresholds. The manufacturing process involves mixing crushed glass aggregates with an unsaturated polyester or epoxy resin binder, pigments, and additives. The mixture is then subjected to vibro-compaction under vacuum, kiln-cured, calibrated, and polished into standardized solid slabs.

subject: sheet set
description: A sample of the product was provided to this office and will be retained for training purposes. The subject merchandise, identified as the “Ladder Lace Cotton Sheet Set,” consists of a flat sheet, a fitted sheet, one or two pillowcases, and a self-fabric bag that serves as the retail packaging. You state that the style number has not yet been assigned to the set. All items within the set are constructed from 100 percent cotton, dyed, woven fabric that is neither printed nor napped. The open end of the pillowcases and the top edge of the flat sheet include a 1 ¼-inch-wide self-fabric cuff. A ladder-like openwork narrow polyester fabric which you describe as embroidery without visible ground is inserted between the body and the cuff of the pillowcases and flat sheet. The approximate width of the polyester insertion is 2/5 inch. The flat sheet is hemmed on the sides and bottom.

subject: decorative aluminum urns
description: Photographs and descriptions of three styles of decorative urns were submitted with your inquiry. The three articles under consideration are described as Decorative Memorial Cremation Urns Made of Casted Aluminum. These aluminum handcrafted urns are manufactured through a casting process and are individually hand-finished. The exterior surfaces are decorated with engraved artwork, themed memorial designs, painted finishes, powder coating, and other decorative treatments. The item described as a Classic Urn measures 10.5 x 7 inches. The item described as a Teardrop Urn is produced in multiple sizes: 10 x 8 inches or 12 x 8.5 inches. The item described as a Keepsake Urn measures 3 x 1.75 inches. The Classic Urn and Teardrop Urn are intended for the containment and display of cremated human remains, while the Keepsake urn is intended to hold a symbolic portion of cremated remains.

subject: Christmas crackers
description: You submitted a sample of six items packed together, identified as Christmas crackers, (no item number included), which consist of reusable Christmas table decorations. The crackers are identical and made of two stiff cardboard tubes that fit together tightly. Both tubes are encased in woven cotton textile fabric, with fabric ends and ribbon ties, formed in the traditional Christmas cracker shape. The crackers are sold empty, without snap mechanisms or contents. The purchaser would load the crackers with items like a small toy, a corny joke or riddle, and a textile fabric crown. The snap mechanism is inserted into the rolled up crown. When pulled, the resulting friction causes a small explosive “pop” when the two tubes separate, spilling out the ”prizes.” The snap mechanisms are chemically impregnated strips are sold separately, along with the reusable textile fabric crowns.

subject: Utility Terrain Vehicles (UTVs)
description: The items under consideration have been identified as four (4) models of utility terrain vehicles (UTVs), which you state are designed for off-road use in industrial, commercial, utility, rescue, municipal, and recreational applications. None of these vehicles are street-legal and are none are intended for operation on public highways. The first vehicle has been identified as the Can-Am Defender XU. It features a selectable two-wheel drive (2WD) and four-wheel drive (4WD) modes, and an auto-locking front differential. It is a four-wheeled utility vehicle with 95 hp and 70 lb.-ft. powered by a 999-cc internal combustion engine and designed for use in work-oriented environments. The vehicle is marketed by BRP under its ranching and farming category and is intended primarily for agricultural applications involving the short-distance transport of goods.

subject: decorative artificial wreath and wreath set
description: Images were provided in lieu of samples. There are two products under consideration. The first is described as an artificial wreath with wildflowers, item number 45244701. This 22-inch wreath features polystyrene plastic flowers and a mostly obscured wreath base made from Lygodium Japonicum (Japanese climbing fern) vines. Your submission indicates that the wreath is assembled using glue. It will be available in one color. The second is a set of two smaller artificial wreaths with wildflowers, item 452447801. Except for size, these 10-inch wreaths are the same as the one described above. They will be available in two assorted colors.

subject: winemaking machinery
description: The merchandise under consideration is described as a complete pump-over system for tannin and aroma extraction (model: FWXU / D1150 H4200 0/ATM V2). The system is designed for commercial and industrial winemaking operations during red wine fermentation. A pump is used to impel fermenting juice from the bottom of a fermenting tank and spray it over the solid grape skins floating at the top, ensuring maximum extraction of color, flavor, and tannins. The imported system includes the following interconnected components: Stainless steel fermentation tank vessel. Flexible impeller electric pump – permanently mounted and integrated into the tank structure. Stainless steel suction/discharge piping – connects the pump inlet to the tank lower drain port and the pump outlet to the sparger at the top of the tank.

subject: coated paper house model
description: Product information and photos were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is item 460331, a decorative paperboard house or church. You indicate that the item is sold around Christmas time, but the house does not incorporate any Christmas motifs. It is a house constructed of coated paperboard, with two trees in the yard, and a picket fence surrounding the whole item. There is a light inside the house, but the house does not illuminate a room like a lamp. You do not provide the dimensions of the house, but it does appear to be the size of a tabletop centerpiece.

subject: Saturnia stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Saturnia stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. Saturnia is a charcoal gray to black stone mottled with patches of brown and white flecks. From the information you provided, it will measure between 115 to 122 inches in length, between 65 to 75 inches in width, and either 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches in thickness. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for such applications as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and surfaces for office furniture. Laboratory analysis has determined that Saturnia is a non-calcareous metamorphic rock. The top of the stone has been polished and the sides are simply cut or sawn.

subject: Thanksgiving decoration
description: You submitted a photograph and a detailed description of an item identified as Harvest Fabric Bow Tie, item number BCBS2027H001, which consists of a single-sided wall or door hanging decoration. Although the requestor identifies the item as a “bow tie,” the item cannot be worn as a necktie. The item features a jute loop for hanging on a wall or door. The decoration depicts a bow with long tails prominently featuring a cutout leaf design with the printed greeting “Happy Thanksgiving.” The leaf design is permanently attached to the knot of the stuffed textile bow. The stuffed bow decoration measures approximately 12" long x 2” wide x 16" high.

subject: Cygnus Brown stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Cygnus Brown stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. Cygnus Brown is a taupe-colored stone with streaks of white, dark gray, and black. From the information you provided, it will measure between 115 to 122 inches in length, between 65 to 75 inches in width, and either 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches in thickness. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for such applications as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and surfaces for office furniture. Laboratory analysis has determined that Cygnus Brown is a non-calcareous metamorphic rock. The top of the stone has been polished and the sides are simply cut or sawn.

subject: fan
description: Model 1PAFFLEXR is identified as a 6" rechargeable USB fan or a portable stroller fan. The circular fan features a power button, indicators for charging and fan speed, a hook that allows the fan to be hung and three flexible legs that allow the fan to be placed on a flat surface or wrapped around the handle of a stroller, a chair, a car seat, etc. The fan is powered by a rechargeable battery.

subject: heart rate monitor
description: Descriptive literature was provided for our review. The merchandise under consideration is the IHT Spirit Heart Rate Monitor (Spirit HRM), a wrist-worn, battery-powered, Bluetooth-enabled wireless wearable health device engineered to monitor and track physical effort. This device features a secure, multi-component plastic housing comprising a top cover, a bottom cover, a sealing rubber gasket, and an adjustable wrist strap, all designed within an IP-rated waterproof enclosure for active use. Internally, its operation is managed by a Main Board containing a Microcontroller Unit (MCU), control circuitry, a rechargeable internal battery, and a digital display screen. Magnetic charger connectors are integrated into the lower casing for recharging. The system incorporates an optical heart rate sensing module (OHR Board) that utilizes photoplethysmography (PPG) technology.

subject: Fournier Rotary Press
description: Descriptive literature was provided for our review. The item under consideration is the Fournier Rotary Press, which is a dewatering system for industrial and municipal sludge consisting of a sludge pump, a polymer tank, a polymer metering pump, a flocculator and a rotary press connected through a series of pipes, hoses, and electrical wiring. The sludge pump feeds sludge into the flocculator where it is combined with a pre-set ratio of polymer solution that enters the flocculator inlet by means of the polymer metering pump. Through a short period of agitation, the flocculator transforms the sludge and polymer solution into good quality “floc” (flocculated sludge), which is then directed to the rotary press. The rotary press is a circular channel delimited by parallel, rotating chrome-plated stainless steel filter elements on both sides.

subject: silicon-carbon product
description: The product under review is silicon-carbon product that you describe as a high carbon silicon. You state that the product would be used in the steel industry as a carburizer. It appears to consist of silicon carbide, calcium, aluminum, iron, and trace amounts of other elemental materials.

subject: NATURA® WT600
description: Additional information was provided via email dated June 22 and June 25, . NATURA® WT600 is a physically modified waxy tapioca starch, manufactured from waxy tapioca starch as the starting material, which undergoes a physical modification process, specifically dry heat treatment. The pasting profile (gelatinization) of NATURA WT600 has been altered to be more process-tolerant than its native starch counterpart, which is preferable to food manufacturers due to its heat tolerance, acid tolerance, and shear tolerance. NATURA WT600 is superior to its native parental starch, as observed from pasting profiles, such as peak viscosity and breakdown. The product is imported in bulk to be utilized as a clean-label texturizer and structural agent in premium food applications. It is packaged in 25 kg multi-ply paper bags.

subject: shipping pallet
description: Product information and a sample were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is the NetZero shipping pallet. You indicate that the pallet is made of a molded composite containing 71 percent wood particles, 25 percent coconut husk particles, and 4 percent polymeric methylene diphenyl diisocyanate (pMDI), an industrial resin. The NetZero shipping pallet is essentially molded wood particle board. The pallet comes in a single deck version and a double deck version.

subject: Dairy-Free Yogurt Alternatives
description: Three products are under review, called Whole Moon Organic Cultured Pistachio® yogurt alternatives, and described as organic, plant-based, dairy-free, vegan products. The items are imported ready for consumption, packaged in five-ounce cups and twelve to a shipping case. It will be marketed in the United States only for retail sale. The Strawberry Cream contains pistachio ‘milk’ made of water and pistachios, soybeans, coconut meat, strawberries, tapioca starch, cane sugar, pectin, natural flavors, and probiotic cultures. The Golden Mango contains pistachio ‘milk’ made of water and pistachios, soybeans, coconut meat, mango, tapioca starch, cane sugar, pectin, natural flavors, lemon juice concentrate, and probiotic cultures.

subject: sectional sofa components
description: In lieu of samples, technical and illustrative literature, product descriptions, and a manufacturing synopsis were provided for review. Item 1, the “Play Day Pop-Up Loveseat – Left Facing (LF),” item 2, the “Aspen Pop-Up Sofa - LF,” and item 3, the “Aspen Armless Pop-Up Sofa” are modular sectional seating components. The sectional seating components do not incorporate integrated full-size folding mattress components. Information provided states, (1) “[T]he units in question are not sold separately and are only offered for sale as part of a modular sectional,” and (2) the individual seating components are constructed of memory foam cushions, elastic banding, polyester upholstered fabric affixed to wooden frames, and metal pop-up recline mechanisms.

subject: assembly piece
description: Technical information was submitted with your request. The item under consideration is an assembly piece, Product # 110001, identified as “Housing, Slim, GFF, Demo.” This item is part of a larger assembly constructed in the United States to resemble a control panel for an insulin pump. It has no electrical or mechanical function and will be used for demonstration purposes when fully assembled. The item is made of aluminum, rectangularly shaped, and is 71 millimeters in height and 42 millimeters in width. The piece is designed to fit with another piece of similar size to resemble the housing for the control panel and has an X-brace within the piece to prevent any use in a fully functioning insulin pump.

subject: electric heating pad
description: A sample of the product was provided to this office and will be retained for training purposes. The sample, identified as a “Heating Pad” is a Berkshire® electric heating pad designed to be worn over the wearer’s shoulders, neck, and back and is intended to provide heat therapy to relax tight muscles and warmth. The heating pad is composed of four layers consisting of: a top and bottom outer shell of 100 percent polyester knitted plush, dyed, fabrics; a second layer of 100 percent polyester nonwoven needle-punched fabric; and a third layer of 100 percent polyester nonwoven needle-punched fabric bonded to heating wire. When laid flat, the cape-like heating pad measures 26 inches in width and 34 inches in length. When worn, it provides a contoured fit measuring 23 inches across the shoulders and 28 inches in height.

subject: GivingEgg
description: Product information and a sample were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is The GivingEgg, item number AW0326.. The GivingEgg is a two-piece, wooden, egg-shaped container measuring approximately 3.5” in height. The species of wood is black walnut (Juglans nigra), a non-coniferous wood. Inside the container is a metal liner and a tube. The GivingEgg is designed to have a nice message inserted, and then to be hidden for another person to find.

subject: athletic footwear
description: Two styles of athletic footwear submitted with your request were examined and will be returned as requested. Style # 6018774A-BR UA Pulse Storm is a below-the-ankle, unisex, athletic shoe. This style has a unique upper in that there are two forms of functional closures; an elastic lace over a separate tongue, and a slide fastener closure over the lace closure. The external surface area of the upper (esau) is made up of textile with 3D printed rubber/plastic overlays and dots. The rubber/plastic on either side of the slide fastener and the wide rubber/plastic overlays, together with the connected rubber/plastic dots, makes up the majority of the esau. The widely spaced small dots are considered accessories or reinforcements and not included in the esau calculation.

subject: steel self-watering planter
description: Photographs and descriptions of the merchandise were included in your inquiry. The merchandise under consideration is described as a self-watering planter, item # 2052888. This oval-shaped planter is made of steel with a plastic liner. It includes an oval-shaped trellis to support growing plants or herbs, a water level indicator, and a drainage hole with a removable plug. The planter measures 17.1” x 7.2” x 11”. It is designed to be placed on a countertop or hung from a wall or railing and is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. Wall and railing mounting hardware is included.

subject: tote bag
description: You submitted photographs and descriptive information for our review. The article at issue is a tote bag constructed with an outer surface of plastic sheeting. It is designed and sized to provide storage, protection, portability, and organization to personal effects during travel. You have indicated it is for multipurpose use during camping, shopping and picnicking. It measures approximately 15.75 inches x 11.8 inches x 19.7 inches. The bag features wheels, three handles, and a zipper closure.

subject: printed wood block décor
description: Product information and images were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is SKU #45105601, Theme Block Décor. The styles are manufactured from medium density fiberboard (MDF) cut into the shapes of a duck, a bear, and a frog. The MDF is printed with duck, bear, and frog images.

subject: floss pick
description: Technical information was submitted with your request. The product under consideration is a floss pick made of a flat piece of stainless steel. It has a finger grip on one end, two suspension prongs on the other end, and a round knob used to tie a piece of dental floss and secure it between the two prongs so it can be used as a lever for flossing.

subject: tray filler
description: Descriptive literature was provided for our review. The item under consideration is described as the Ellepot 2.0 Pot Filler (also referred to as the Paper Pot 2.0), which is an industrial-scale tray-filling line designed for inside or outside greenhouse environments. The system consists of a main frame (housing a control unit), an integrated 3,000 mm tray conveyor line, a paper roll frame, a paper pulling/grabbing assembly, a pneumatic knife/sawblade cutting unit, and a soil-substrate measuring unit incorporating a telescopic tube system and mechanical stirring arm. In operation, empty cell trays up to 600x400 mm are loaded onto the conveyor belt. Plant substrate (soil mix) is fed from a companion bulk hopper/soil mixer into an entry terminal of the machine (processing up to 4 cubic meters per hour).

subject: gift bags
description: In lieu of a sample, photographs of the items were provided with your request. Items, described as “Reusable Christmas Gift Bags,” are textile bags intended to be used as an alternative to traditional paper gift-wrap. Each bag is composed of 100 percent cotton woven digitally printed fabric. To construct the rectangular-shaped, unlined bag, the fabric is cut, folded over, and hemmed along both side seams. The open end is folded over and hemmed to form a channel in which a double-sided 100 percent polyester woven satin ribbon is inserted. When the ribbon is pulled, it allows the bag to be cinched closed.

subject: parts kit
description: The merchandise under consideration is a kit containing components for the Hercules H-DU lift bot, an automated lifting robot used in Amazon fulfillment centers to lift and transport products. The kit contains four components: an H-DU Linkage Kit Rotary (part number 400-01256), an H-DU Rear Chassis Subassembly (part number 400-02390), an H-DU Panhard Left Assembly (part number 400-01281), and an H-DU Panhard Right Assembly (part number 400-01282). These components can be separated and stored as inventory, sold individually, or sold together as a kit. The H-DU Linkage Kit Rotary is a subassembly for the inner lifting mechanism of the lifting robot and is composed of aluminum castings and steel shafts with plastic bushings. This assembly is driven by an electric motor and used to raise a lifting plate. The motor, gears, and electrical components are not imported with the subassembly.

subject: adjustable aluminum door sill
description: (“CTI”). Illustrative literature, product descriptions and a bill of materials were provided with your request. The subject merchandise, the adjustable aluminum door sill, is a composite good consisting of an aluminum deck, a PVC adjustable top cap, a PVC side cap, a PS substrate base, and steel screws.

subject: structural timber frame kit
description: Product information and photos were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is a structural timber frame kit to construct a robust, permanent gazebo. The structure has posts, trusses, and a roof, but no walls. The kit consists of many structural wood members of Douglas fir (a coniferous wood) that are each shaped with mortise and tenon joinery. The kit includes oak (a non-coniferous wood) pegs for assembly, steel hardware and connectors for assembly, and engineered plans for assembly. The kit does not include any dimensional lumber.

subject: power head
description: Product information was submitted with your request. The item under consideration is described as a 56-volt lithium-ion walk-behind power head (Model WPH1600/WPH1600-FC) designed for use with dedicated outdoor garden and horticultural use attachments. It functions as the powered drive component that converts stored energy from an attached battery into rotary force and delivers it to the attached implement. After the battery and working implement are attached as instructed, the user pushes it by walking behind, manually directing it and controlling the power with the handle assembly. The power head consists of several components including, but not limited to, a wheeled chassis with two wheels, an ergonomic dual handle assembly with trigger switches, a brushless DC motor and gearbox assembly, a PCB assembly, and a battery mounting interface.

subject: insulated cooler bag
description: You have submitted a photograph and descriptive information for our review. The product at issue is an insulated cooler bag constructed with an outer surface of plastics. It is designed to provide storage, protection, portability and organization to food, beverages, and other personal effects. It will also maintain the temperature of food and beverages.

subject: prefabricated home structure
description: Product information and images were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is a prefabricated building structure for residential use. The structural framework of the house unit is constructed predominantly of wood. Wood makes up the framing of the floor, walls, and roof. The unit incorporates some structural steel, but the overall structure of the building is wood. The unit is pre-assembled before importation and the sections are installed together and fixed to a foundation on-site. The unit appears to be fully outfitted with electrical and plumbing and is freestanding when assembled. You indicate that the unit is imported with kitchen appliances. The unit is fully self-contained and is not designed to be assembled with additional units.

subject: Istambul stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Istambul stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. Istambul is a cream-colored stone with streaks and flecks of dark brown, gray, and black. From the information you provided, it will measure between 115 to 122 inches in length, between 65 to 75 inches in width, and either 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches in thickness. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for such applications as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and surfaces for office furniture. Laboratory analysis has determined that Istambul is an igneous stone comprised predominantly of quartz and alkali feldspars, and meets the geological definition of granite.

subject: lemons
description: The subject merchandise is described as whole dried lemons (Citrus limon) that are sun-dried with the peel intact. The lemons do not contain added ingredients or preservatives. The lemons are packaged in eight ounce (227 gram) and one pound (454 gram) sealed plastic bags. The subject merchandise is said to be prepared by first harvesting fresh lemons, subsequent to washing and sun-drying them whole until fully dehydrated. The intended purchasers are food industry distributors and retail stores.

subject: Tadalafil Tablets in dosage form,
description: Tadalafil, imported in dosages of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg and 20 mg tablets, is a phosphodiesterase 5 (PDE5) inhibitor. It is primarily indicated for the treatment of erectile dysfunction. It is also indicated for the treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia, and pulmonary arterial hypertension.

subject: Piracema White stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Piracema White stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. Piracema White is a light gray stone mottled with dark gray and black streaks and banding. From the information you provided, it will measure between 115 to 122 inches in length, between 65 to 75 inches in width, and either 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches in thickness. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for such applications as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and surfaces for office furniture. Laboratory analysis has determined that Piracema White is made of gneiss. The top of the stone has been polished and the sides are simply cut or sawn.

subject: agricultural sprayers and floaters from unspecified countries
description: The items under consideration have been identified as five (5) models of self-propelled agricultural sprayers and floaters. You state that these machines are specifically engineered and designed for spraying fertilizers, chemicals, pesticides, herbicides, manure, and other agricultural materials over farmland. Sprayers are designed primarily for flat or gently sloped terrain and feature: Large-capacity liquid tanks; High-clearance booms; Agricultural spraying systems optimized for efficient field coverage; and Integrated pumping and application systems. These machines are used primarily for liquid or liquid/dry agricultural applications.

subject: sofa sectional storage console
description: Ltd. In lieu of samples, technical and illustrative literature, a product description, and a manufacturing synopsis were provided for review. Item 1987687, the “Leather Storage Console with Hidden Cupholders,” is a modular sofa sectional unit. The upholstered sofa sectional unit is constructed of leather, foam, polyester fiber, and polyvinyl chloride (PVC) that is affixed to a wooden frame. The wooden frame consists of engineered wood materials that include (1) plywood, (2) laminated veneer lumber (LVL) and Southern pine wood. The modular sofa sectional unit will have USB-A and USB-C charging ports and a storage compartment with a pair of cupholders. The modular sofa sectional seating unit contains assembly hardware in the form of connection posts and/or connection clips for integration and assembly onto additional sofa sectional units (sold separately).

subject: sofa sectional and sofa sectional components
description: In lieu of samples, technical and illustrative literature, a product description, and a manufacturing synopsis were provided for review. Model , the “Power Reclining Chaise Sectional Sofa,” is an upholstered sofa sectional constructed of a wooden frame. The sofa sectional components include (1) Left-Arm Facing (LAF) Power Recliner (AL1.5-1E), (2) Armless Chair (D1.5), (3) Round Corner (C), (4) Armless Power Chair (D1.5-1E), (5) Straight Console with USB (HCE), and (6) Right-Arm Facing (RAF) Power Chaise (TR1.5-PE). The sofa sectional does not incorporate an integrated mattress component and does not convert into a bed. The upholstered backrests, seat foundations, and the armrests incorporate “S” tension springs, foam, textile tension bands bound to the wooden structural frames, and fiber encased in textiles. The sofa sectional will provide seating for one or more individuals.

subject: lapel pins
description: You have submitted photographs and descriptions on four lapel pins. Sku# D08185-LP-10 is a 10-Year Service Anniversary Lapel Pin. It is 20mm in diameter and is composed of 10K gold and contains two synthetic ruby stones which are 2.2mm in diameter each. Sku# D08185-LP-15 is a 15-Year Service Anniversary Lapel Pin. It is 20mm in diameter and is composed of 10K gold and contains three synthetic emerald stones which are 2.2mm in diameter each. Sku# D08185-LP-20 is a 20-Year Service Anniversary Lapel Pin. It is 20mm in diameter and is composed of 10K gold and contains two A21 diamonds which are 2.2mm in diameter each. Sku# D08185-LP-25 is a 25-Year Service Anniversary Lapel Pin. It is 20mm in diameter and is composed of 10K gold and contains two A21 diamonds which are 2.2mm in diameter each, and one synthetic emerald stone.

subject: enameled sheet metal street number plates from the Netherlands
description: Photographs and descriptions of the merchandise were included in your inquiry. The articles under consideration are described as sheet metal street number plates. These door address plates measure approximately 2” x 3” and are imported with the numbers printed on them. They have pre-drilled mounting holes, but mounting hardware is not included.

subject: MOSFET transistors
description: The merchandise under consideration is described as metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFET), part numbers DMC2053UVTQ-7, and DMC2053UVTQ-13 which are general-purpose transistors used in various automotive applications for backlighting, DC-DC converters, and power management functions. The two device variants are identical, with their only difference being the packaging, as DMC2053UVTQ-7 is supplied on a 7-inch reel and DMC2053UVTQ-13 is supplied on a 13-inch reel. The transistors are comprised of an N-Channel die and P-Channel die packaged in a TSOT26 case with 6 terminal pins. You state that the operating frequency of the transistor is 1 Mhz. According to the provided datasheet, the power dissipation rate is 0.7 W when mounted with the minimum recommended pad layout, and 1.1 W when using a 1-inch square copper plate.

subject: F2 Electrical Enclosure Assembly
description: The merchandise under consideration in this request is the F2 Electrical Enclosure Assembly, which is described as a base structure of sheet metal construction designed to be the mounting surfaces for electrical components including the main control board (a printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) populated with numerous electrical components), a programmable logic controller, an etherCAT coupler module, a serial communications module, a 16-channel digital input module, a 16-channel digital output module, a 1-channel servomotor drive module, two 1-channel stepper motor drive modules, a cooling fan, and several electrical cables. In use, the subassembly functions as the “brain” of the Fastmill.io dental milling machine where it provides electrical power and control to other components of the dental milling machine.

subject: steel TV wall mount bracket
description: Photographs and descriptions of the merchandise were included in your inquiry. The article under consideration is a TV wall mounting bracket made of steel. It functions to mount a flat panel TV to a wall or other vertical structure. This full motion mount can support screen sizes ranging from 13-77 inches. Mounting hardware is included. You note that there is no aluminum in this article.

subject: Copenhagen stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Copenhagen stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. Copenhagen is an ivory-colored stone mottled with dark gray. From the information you provided, it will measure between 115 to 122 inches in length, between 65 to 75 inches in width, and either 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches in thickness. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for such applications as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and surfaces for office furniture. Laboratory analysis has determined that Copenhagen is made of granite. The top of the stone has been polished and the sides are simply cut or sawn.

subject: Desert Atlas stone
description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Desert Atlas stone. A sample was submitted with your ruling request and was forwarded to the Customs and Border Protection Laboratory for analysis. This analysis has been completed. Desert Atlas is a sage gray stone with large patches of dark green, olive, amber, and cream. From the information you provided, it will measure between 115 to 122 inches in length, between 65 to 75 inches in width, and either 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches in thickness. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for such applications as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and surfaces for office furniture. Laboratory analysis has determined that Desert Atlas is an igneous rock which contains almost no quartz. The top of the stone has been polished and the sides are simply cut or sawn.

subject: paper rolls
description: Product information and a photo were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is described as absorbent paper in jumbo roll form. The paper rolls are manufactured from 100% virgin wood pulp through a conventional papermaking process. The finished absorbent paper is uncoated, white, lightweight, with a thin sheet structure. The rolls will be imported in different widths: Item No. 700035 measures 480 mm, Item No. 70039 measure 520 mm, Item No. 700040 measures 600 mm, and Item No. 700041 measures 650mm, each with a basis weight of 13 grams per square meter. You indicate the absorbent paper rolls are used as raw materials in the manufacture of adult and pet care pads. However, it does not contain superabsorbent polymers (SAP) and is not intended to function as the primary absorbent core.

subject: aluminum business cards and table signs
description: Photographs and descriptions of the merchandise were included in your inquiry. The articles under consideration are described as aluminum business cards and table signs. Each item is made of aluminum and measures 3.375 inches x 2.125 inches. The table signs and one style of the business cards are printed onto anodized aluminum using laser-ablation. The remaining style of business cards is printed onto polymer coated aluminum using sublimation printing. The table signs are used in a restaurant as "RESERVED" signs on a table, or for description of wines, beers, or cocktails on a sampling offering. Each item is imported with the information printed on it at the time of importation.

subject: playground set part
description: Technical drawings were provided in lieu of a sample. The article under consideration is described as a panoramic window, item number 1231728. You state that the window is specifically designed for use in a playground set, Lifetime’s Space Adventure Playset, Model 91387, a three-level tower that includes a tube slide and swing set. The clear window is made of polyethylene terephthalate glycol (PETG) and is vacuum formed in one round piece. It measures 26 inches in diameter at the connection point of window to playset, seven inches in width extending out from the playset, and 0.12 inches in thickness.

subject: steel awning brackets
description: Photographs and descriptions of the merchandise were included in your inquiry. The articles under consideration are described as heavy-duty steel awning brackets. They are unpainted, steel, colonial style brackets that are cut, welded, and pre-drilled for installation. The brackets are permanently affixed to the exterior walls of buildings and function to mount a structural awning to the building and to support its weight over doors, windows, or patios. The awnings are imported in three different sizes to accommodate different awning projections: 12" x 24", 15" x 30", and 14" x 36". Wall mounting hardware is included.

subject: programmable autonomous racecar
description: The merchandise under consideration is identified as the Neoracer, which is described as an Artificial Intelligence (AI)-driven autonomous vehicle platform. The device consists of a 1:12 scale racecar, equipped with a brushed motor and 4-wheel-drive drivetrain. The car further incorporates a LiDar and camera module. On the top of the car is an AI compute board, which is comprised of an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano module. This board contains a graphics processing unit (GPU), central processing unit (CPU) cores, a fan, and multiple connection points. The subject scaled racecar is used by universities and other educational institutions as well as AI researchers and advanced hobbyists in order to teach and research advanced AI programming. The specific user plugs the processing board into a computer where they use various programming languages, i.e.

subject: 3D Pokémon model
description: Product information and a sample were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is SKU #44712401, Pokémon 3D Puzzle Model Kit. The item is a 9.2”-high, three-dimensional model of a Pokémon character that the user assembles. The model is constructed from die-cut pieces with tab and slot assembly. The pieces are constructed of a sheet of polystyrene foam sandwiched between two sheets of printed, coated paperboard. The foam gives the pieces dimension and stability. The paperboard provides stability and the decorative printing imparts the consumer interest.

subject: decorative artificial wreath set
description: Images were provided in lieu of a sample. The product under consideration is described as “PSJH27 ARTIF WRTH MINI 2A,” item number DB1-RSMRA016BC. It includes two wreaths, one with blue plastic flowers and the other with pink plastic flowers. The flowers are attached to molded plastic stems, and both feature a mostly obscured wreath base made from toad vine. Your submission indicates that these wreaths are assembled by binding the components together with paper tape.

subject: Steel Liquid Containment Barriers
description: Illustrative literature, product descriptions and a bill of materials were provided with your request. The products under consideration are two types of Steel Liquid Containment Barriers: The FM Fire Spillbarrier and The TÜV Chemical Spillbarrier. The Steel Liquid Containment Barriers are devices designed to prevent the uncontrolled release and spread of liquids through openings such as doorways, gates, and access areas within industrial facilities. These barriers are constructed for installation flush with the floor, positioned either in front of or within an opening where liquid containment is a critical requirement. Each barrier system comprises several key components: a movable barrier flap, robust side posts, effective sealing elements, an integrated floor housing for containment, mechanical closing mechanisms, and other necessary parts to ensure its automatic containment function.

subject: religious book
description: D escription and a sample were submitted for our review. In your ruling request, you indicate the goods consist of traditional Hebrew items, specifically prayer books, religious books, Bibles, and religious books intended for prayer and study. However, we only received one sample, which you identified as the “Hebrew Book of Psalms (Tehillim).” This ruling will be based on the sample we received. The item under consideration is a softcover book, which you identified as the “Hebrew Book of Psalms (Tehillim).” The book contains 128 pages of Hebrew text, features a faux leather cover made of polyurethane, and measures approximately 8.25 cm x 11.5 cm. According to the website sefaria.org, a non-profit, open-source digital library, “Psalms (“Tehillim”), the first book of the section in the Hebrew Bible called Writings, is an anthology of 150 poems attributed to King David and to others.

subject: blow pad
description: The article under consideration is described as a blow pad (Part Name: BLOW PAD FRT LH NO.1_ICE), Part Number: WE76CA06001A, which is an original equipment manufacturer (OEM) good used in passenger vehicles. The blow pad is installed beneath the driver-side floor mat to absorb impact when stepping on the pedals. It is made of a high-density polyethylene (HDPE) injection molded part, with polyurethane (PU) foam molded onto it, and a fiber pad, which serves to block and protect against the inflow of foaming liquid into the inside of the injection-molded part during the foaming process. The blow pad is made into a specific shape and measures 275 x 333 x 60 mm or 10.83 × 13.11 × 2.36 inches.

subject: decorative pillow cover
description: In lieu of a sample, photographs were submitted with your request. The subject merchandise, item name “ZANZIBAR No 56,” is a decorative pillow cover measuring 20 x 20 inches, designed to encase a removable pillow insert, imported separately. The decorative pillow cover is made of 100 percent linen woven fabric. The article features a self-flange, knife edge, center back envelope closure, and two gold-toned metal eyelets (grommets) positioned diagonally in the upper left-hand corner of the front panel, one along the top edge and one on the left edge. A gold-toned stainless-steel chain with a leather ‘MIYA’ brand accent tab is threaded through the eyelets and the ends secured. A decorative blue organza ribbon bow and charms consisting of beads, metal pendants, natural shells and pompons hang from the metal chain on the front side.

subject: United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) of Dicamba DMA and Dicamba DGA Herbicides
description: The first item under consideration is Dicamba DMA Herbicide, labeled as “Oracle.” You indicate that it is an agricultural herbicide used for weed control in corn, sorghum, small grains, pasture, hay rangelands, general farmstead non-cropland, fallow, sugarcane, asparagus, turf and grass seed crops. The herbicide will be imported in 2.5-gallon jugs. The second item under consideration is Dicamba DGA Herbicide, labeled as “Oracle Advanced.

subject: outdoor coir door mats
description: Samples of the two mats and photographs detailing the manufacturing process were provided. The samples will be returned as requested. The submitted sample, identified as "STRIPE-2," is a rectangular outdoor coir door mat with rubber backing measuring approximately 18 x 30 inches. To manufacture, woven coir fabric is layered between two sheets of rubber over a mold which creates the design. The layers are heated and compressed in a hydraulic press to create a rubber design on the front and a rubber backing. The face of the mat features a geometric ribbed striped pattern design and a one-inch ribbed border. The majority of the surface area is of coir woven fabric. The submitted sample, identified as "CAT-1," is a rectangular outdoor coir door mat measuring approximately 18 x 30 inches. The face of the mat features a decorative design impression depicting a cat flanked by eight paw prints.

subject: decorative artificial wreath
description: Images were provided in lieu of a sample. The product under consideration is described as “PSJH27 ARTIF WRTH WLDFLWR,” item number DB1-RS161. This wreath features blue plastic flowers attached to molded plastic stems, and a mostly obscured wreath base made from toad vine. Your submission indicates that the wreath is assembled by binding the components together with paper tape.

subject: iron wire and LED bow decoration
description: Photographs and descriptions of the merchandise were included in your inquiry. The merchandise under consideration is described as an LED Bow Decoration, Item number 1851620.

subject: children’s book
description: Detailed description and a PDF version of the book were submitted for our review. The item under consideration is a hardcover board book entitled "Julia and Emi’s Hawaiian Fishy Friends." The book contains 24 illustrated pages with text and measures approximately 7.87” x 7.87”. The book follows two sisters, Julia and Emi, as they embark on an underwater adventure in Hawaii. The text on each spread describes interesting facts about the appearance, behavior and unique characteristics of the reef fish they encountered, accompanied by an illustration of the fish with its common name and Hawaiian name. The book also emphasizes the importance of ocean safety and caring for the marine environment.

subject: document cases
description: You have submitted samples of four document cases for our review. The articles at issue are document cases. Style numbers were not available. In correspondence with our office, you indicated that the articles are primarily intended to be used by consumers to carry documents from one location to another. In addition to portability, they will also provide storage, organization, and protection to the intended contents. The first style is constructed with an outer surface of either plastic sheeting or genuine leather. It measures 12.6 in x 10.83 in x 0.79 in. It features four internal compartments and a magnetic flap closure. The second style is constructed with an outer surface of either plastic sheeting or genuine leather. It measures 10.24 in x 12.99 in x 0.87 in. It features four removable dividers and a small flap closure.

subject: compact milling machine and parts
description: The items under consideration include a compact milling machine, F2 XYZ Mech Assembly, F2 Right Cover Assembly, F2 Back Cover Assembly, and F2 Manifold Assembly. The compact milling machine, Fastmill.io, is designed for dental professionals to create custom dental prostheses for individual patients. The machine is built from several sub-assemblies mounted on a base frame and enclosed by protective plastic panels. It features a central precision assembly for dental milling, supported by various systems that enhance its performance and reliability. The F2 XYZ Mech Assembly is the central subassembly of the compact milling machine, housing all the linear motion and automation components necessary for precise dental milling. It utilizes a 4-axis cartesian mechanism to move both the spindle and material holder in coordination, enabling the production of single unit dental restorations.

subject: compact milling machine parts
description: The items under consideration include the F2 Base Support Assembly and F2 Base Divider Assembly, which are subassemblies of a compact dental milling machine, Fastmill.io (addressed under a separate cover in NY N361752). Separate rulings will address F2 Air Pump Assembly, F2 Coolant Pump Assembly and F2 Electrical Enclosure Assembly. As you noted in your submission, all of these parts do not have independent functions outside of the milling system and are used exclusively for the operation, control or mechanical functioning of the dental milling machine. The F2 Base Support Assembly is a subassembly of the dental milling machine that forms the base structure of the mill. It is specifically designed to hold the drawer containing the coolant trough and the coolant flow meter.

subject: compact milling machine parts
description: The items under consideration include the F2 Door Assembly, F2 Coolant Trough Assembly, F2 Coolant Intake Assembly and F2 Basin Assembly, which are subassemblies of a compact dental milling machine, Fastmill.io (addressed under a separate cover in NY N361752). A separate ruling will address the F2 LED Assembly. As you noted in your submission, all of these parts do not have independent functions outside of the milling system and are used exclusively for the operation, control or mechanical functioning of the dental milling machine. The F2 Door Assembly is a subassembly of the dental milling machine. It consists of a plastic door that encloses the cutting area and features a window for viewing the restoration process. The door mounts to a multi-piece sheet metal frame, which provides proper alignment and includes features for attaching to guide rails during final assembly.

subject: plastic foam pad
description: Images were provided in lieu of a sample. The product under consideration is described as a reticulated polyurethane foam component for incorporation into your DrainMate™ oil drain container. It is a single piece of die-cut open-cell reticulated polyurethane foam that is circular in shape and intended to suppress splashing and agitation of used motor oil as it is drained from a vehicle into the container. It is approximately 11 inches in diameter and 3/8 inches in thickness. Your submission indicates that this pad will not serve as a filter, is non-replaceable, will not be sold separately, and will remain permanently incorporated within the finished oil drain container during normal use.

subject: magnetic article sorting system
description: The item under consideration is a magnetic article sorting system (MASS). The system is designed for use in material recovery and recycling facilities to separate ferrous metal from mixed recyclable waste streams without human assistance. The MASS consists of an integrated overhead permanent magnet, magnet housing/support assembly, ferrous discharge chute/deflector arrangement, conveyor, hopper/sidewall assembly, guarding, controls, and related support components. In operation, mixed recyclable material is loaded into the system and conveyed through a magnetic separation zone. As the material passes underneath the overhead permanent magnet, ferrous metal is attracted to the magnetic field and removed from the mixed material stream. The captured item is directed to a dedicated discharge area designated for ferrous material.
